anatolia_ppn_0027.title: Gobekli Tepe 2.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0037.title: GobeklitepeHeykel.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0037.notes_sonnet: A carved stone pillar with a smooth rectangular upper section and a narrower shaft below bearing a low-relief animal figure, possibly a quadruped, set among rough stone rubble walls.

anatolia_ppn_0041.title: Göbekli Tepe (2).jpg
anatolia_ppn_0041.notes: An upright rectangular stone slab with a rounded top bears a low-relief four-legged animal in profile on its broad face, with fainter, heavily eroded carved shapes below it, set among dry-stone walling.
anatolia_ppn_0041.notes_sonnet: A tall rounded-top stone pillar shows a shallow relief carving of a single four-legged animal on its front face, set among surrounding stone rubble walls.

anatolia_ppn_0045.title: Göbekli Tepe - Türkei 2011 174.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0045.notes: A weathered rectangular stone block bears shallow relief divided by a horizontal groove into two bands, each containing repeated arch- or handle-topped shapes and rows of zigzag/chevron patterning, with a large plain rounded disc-like form in the lower band.
anatolia_ppn_0045.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone slab shows an upper row of arch-like handled shapes resembling containers, a middle band of zigzag pattern, and a lower area with a circular form and an elongated curved object.

anatolia_ppn_0072.title: Göbeklitepe Building C 5301.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0072.notes: A single low-relief four-legged animal in profile with an arched back and long tail occupies the upper-middle portion of a broken stone slab's broad face.
anatolia_ppn_0072.notes_sonnet: A worn stone slab shows a single low-relief carving of an elongated four-legged animal in profile, positioned centrally on the smooth face, with the surrounding area left plain.

anatolia_ppn_0078.title: Göbeklitepe Building C 5372 (cropped).jpg
anatolia_ppn_0078.notes: A rectangular stone block carved in low relief with rows of small animal figures, mostly four-legged creatures in profile plus one long-necked beaked-looking animal, set against a net or lattice-like ground, with a toothed animal head near the lower broken edge and a drilled round hole through the slab.
anatolia_ppn_0078.notes_sonnet: A large stone block carved with two overlapping quadruped figures set against a background of an incised crosshatch/lattice pattern covering the whole surface.

anatolia_ppn_0080.title: Göbeklitepe Building C 5373.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0080.notes: A tall narrow stone pillar carved on its narrow face with a small high-relief animal shown head-downward and, below it, a low-relief arm ending in a splayed hand, set amid dry-stone walling.
anatolia_ppn_0080.notes_sonnet: A carved stone pillar shows a raised relief of a small four-legged animal in the upper middle area and a faint, shallowly incised outline of another quadruped-like shape below it, set against a dry-stone rubble wall.

anatolia_ppn_0082.title: Göbeklitepe Building C 5376.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0082.notes: A large upright T-shaped stone block set in a rough stone wall bears weathered low-relief animal figures, with elongated four-legged creatures on the upper part of the shaft and a low, long-bodied animal near the base, alongside a second fallen slab with faint traces of carving.
anatolia_ppn_0082.notes_sonnet: A large upright stone pillar set within a stone-walled enclosure bears a carved surface showing an abstract lattice-like patterned band in the upper portion and a four-legged animal figure carved in low relief near the lower portion, with a circular perforation between them.

anatolia_ppn_0083.title: Göbeklitepe Building C 5378.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0083.notes: A tall upright stone slab bearing a single low-relief elongated four-legged animal in profile across the upper portion, the rest of the face left plain and weathered.
anatolia_ppn_0083.notes_sonnet: A tall stone pillar with a shallow low-relief carving of a single four-legged animal in profile on its upper face, set against a background of dry-stacked stone walling.

anatolia_ppn_0084.title: Göbeklitepe Building C 5379.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0084.notes: A single low-relief four-legged animal in profile with arched back and long tail occupies the middle of a weathered upright stone slab.
anatolia_ppn_0084.notes_sonnet: A single low-relief carving of a long-bodied, short-legged quadruped with an elongated tail is visible on a worn, roughly rectangular stone slab.

anatolia_ppn_0086.title: Göbeklitepe Building C sept 2019 5373crop.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0086.notes: On the narrow face of an upright stone block, a four-limbed animal is carved in bold high relief descending head-downward, and below it a flatter low relief shows a pair of arms ending in splayed, long-fingered hands; loose rubble masonry fills the background at right.
anatolia_ppn_0086.notes_sonnet: A carved stone pillar edge shows a large curled quadruped figure with visible limbs and a curved tail-like appendage in the upper register, and a smaller, shallower incised quadruped figure below it in a second register.

anatolia_ppn_0088.title: Göbeklitepe Building C sept 2019 5376crop.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0088.notes: A large stone slab bears low relief animal figures in profile facing right — a larger long-limbed creature in the upper area and a smaller one below — with a round drilled hole in the upper right, partly obscured by metal cables.
anatolia_ppn_0088.notes_sonnet: A carved stone block shows a larger four-legged animal figure with visible legs and horn-like protrusion above a smaller quadruped figure below, with a circular hole carved into the upper right of the block and modern cables strung across the surface.

anatolia_ppn_0093.title: Göbeklitepe Building D 5320.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0093.notes: A tall dressed stone slab bears a shallow low-relief carving of a small profile bird-like creature with an angular beak-like head and two bent legs, set above and beside long curving raised outlines that continue down the block, with modern wooden bracing above.
anatolia_ppn_0093.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface shows a bird-like figure in profile with stylized clawed feet above a curving band near the bottom edge.

anatolia_ppn_0095.title: Göbeklitepe Building D 5323.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0095.notes: A tall upright slab carved in low relief with stacked horizontal rows of animal figures — arched-backed four-legged creatures above and long-necked/long-legged creatures below — separated by hatched and zigzag patterned bands, with further carving on the narrow side face.
anatolia_ppn_0095.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone slab shows an upper band of repeated arch-like or plant motifs, a middle zone with a circular shape and a bird-like figure in low relief, and a lower zone with faint chevron patterning.

anatolia_ppn_0103.title: Göbeklitepe Building D 5389.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0103.notes: A stone pillar carved in low relief with a single slender four-legged animal in profile descending head-down in the upper area, above a long curved raised line and a narrow band near the lower edge.
anatolia_ppn_0103.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a single low-relief quadruped figure with legs bent, set within a large curved triangular border line, with modern support rods visible to the right.

anatolia_ppn_0105.title: Göbeklitepe Building D 5391.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0105.notes: A weathered rectangular stone block carved in low relief with stacked horizontal bands of animal figures in profile, including arched-backed four-legged creatures above a hatched textured strip and further striding animals below.
anatolia_ppn_0105.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows three horizontal bands: an upper band of repeated arch-like or leaf-like shapes, a middle band containing a seated human figure, a round object, and a slender vertical shape, and a lower band with an elongated bird-like form beneath a small scorpion-like shape.

anatolia_ppn_0106.title: Göbeklitepe Building D 5392.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0106.notes: A rectangular stone block carved in low relief with two horizontal bands: an upper row of arched, humped animal-like forms topped by repeated short comb-like strokes, and a lower row of crouching or crawling creatures in profile beneath a similar fringed line.
anatolia_ppn_0106.notes_sonnet: A carved stone block shows an upper register of repeated arched quadruped forms separated by a small tree, a zigzag band dividing the registers, and a lower register with a bird-like head, a circular shape, and a curving reptilian or animal tail.

anatolia_ppn_0107.title: Göbeklitepe Building D 5393.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0107.notes: A tall worked stone slab set in rubble bears low-relief and lightly incised animal forms stacked vertically: sinuous elongated creatures near the upper block, a faint incised long-legged creature mid-surface, and a clear profile bird-like figure with curved beak near the base.
anatolia_ppn_0107.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface shows a disc and a small quadruped-like shape in an upper band, an abstract interwoven pattern in a middle band, and a bird-like profile figure carved into a lower broken section, all surrounded by rubble.

anatolia_ppn_0111.title: Göbeklitepe Building D sept 2019 5388crop.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0111.notes: A weathered stone block face carries two vertical columns of repeated chevron/herringbone carving flanking a plainer central panel, with a projecting undecorated block above.
anatolia_ppn_0111.notes_sonnet: A worn stone surface carved with two vertical bands of repeated chevron/zigzag patterning flanking a plain central panel, set below a smooth undecorated cap.

anatolia_ppn_0121.title: Karahan Tepe - Turkey, July 2025 - 54640846121.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0121.notes: A weathered upright stone figure carved in the round, with a large head, arms folded to the front with fingers indicated, a smaller animal/bird-like form in low relief on the chest, and a rounded knob-like protrusion at the waist level, partly embedded among stone blocks and earth.
anatolia_ppn_0121.notes_sonnet: A carved stone human-form statue with a face, arms crossed at the chest, and a round object at the waist, standing upright among rubble and stonework.

anatolia_ppn_0122.title: Karahan Tepe - Turkey, July 2025 - 54641065499.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0122.notes: A weathered, broken upright stone block bears low-relief animal-like forms with splayed, striated limb or ray shapes in the upper part, together with a rounded knob-like head projecting in high relief from the middle, the lower portion being plain and damaged.
anatolia_ppn_0122.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone relief carved in high relief showing what appears to be an animal head with a rounded protruding snout or nose and carved folds or drapery-like ridges on the body, set into a rock-cut wall.

anatolia_ppn_0129.title: Karahan Tepe head (de-shadowed).jpg
anatolia_ppn_0129.notes: A weathered carved stone head with a frontal face, heavy brow ridges, ears at the sides, a bared row of gridded teeth, and a scalloped ridged cap or headdress across the top.
anatolia_ppn_0129.notes_sonnet: A carved stone head with a tiered, scalloped headdress or hairstyle, large ears, an incised toothy mouth, and a weathered, pitted surface.

anatolia_ppn_0130.title: Karahan Tepe human face (close up).jpg
anatolia_ppn_0130.notes: A carved stone head with frontal face showing brow ridges, nose, eyes and lips, emerging from surrounding earth/sediment, with a flat cut top and no other imagery visible.
anatolia_ppn_0130.notes_sonnet: A single weathered, roughly carved human face protrudes from an eroded stone or mudbrick surface, with no other decorative elements visible.

anatolia_ppn_0132.title: Karahan Tepe in-situ small stone vessel.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0132.notes: A small corroded cylindrical vessel resting on dry ground, decorated just below the rim with a single incised band of repeated zigzag/chevron marks.
anatolia_ppn_0132.notes_sonnet: A small rounded container with a narrow band of zigzag incised decoration near its rim, filled with soil and resting on a rock surface.

anatolia_ppn_0142.title: Karahan Tepe vulture. Şanlıurfa - Archeology Museum, July 2025.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0142.notes: A carved stone three-dimensional figure of a hook-beaked bird seen in profile, its folded wing and body rendered with rows of parallel incised lines suggesting feathers, resting on stout legs.
anatolia_ppn_0142.notes_sonnet: A single three-dimensional stone sculpture of a bird with a hooked beak, turned head, folded wings showing carved feather ridges, and clawed feet, mounted on a museum stand.

anatolia_ppn_0144.title: Leopardenskulptur.Karahantepe.MNR.25966.P1067778.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0144.notes: A heavily worn, eroded stone block carved in the round into an elongated animal-like body with a projecting limb below and faint incised lines at one end.
anatolia_ppn_0144.notes_sonnet: A worn, elongated carved stone form resembling an animal head/muzzle with a faint incised lattice pattern near the mouth area.

anatolia_ppn_0155.title: Periodo neolitico, testa umana, in calcare, da nevali çori-sanliurfa, 8500-7900 ac ca. (museo di sanliurfa).jpg
anatolia_ppn_0155.notes: A vertical eroded stone block carved in the round with a frontal human-like face showing deep-set brow ridge, two hollowed eye sockets and a projecting nose, topped by a broad raised band across the forehead.
anatolia_ppn_0155.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone carving depicting a large human face with heavy brow, deep-set eyes, and a worn nose and mouth, mounted on a plain base.

anatolia_ppn_0163.title: Steingefaess.Chlorit.Karahantepe.MNR.25365.P1067751.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0163.notes: A rounded dark vessel, cracked and partly broken, covered over its whole body with finely incised hatched triangles, chevrons and lattice-filled panels forming a continuous abstract field.
anatolia_ppn_0163.notes_sonnet: A rounded vessel surface is covered edge to edge with a dense incised lattice of crosshatched triangular and zigzag lines forming a single continuous abstract pattern field.

anatolia_ppn_0174.title: Tentative reconstruction of the ‘totem pole’ from Nevalı Çori.png
anatolia_ppn_0174.notes: A tall carved pillar drawn in three stacked zones: a large profile bird with folded striated wings at the top, a middle zone of two mirrored beaked/animal-headed upper bodies with crosshatched surfaces and long crossed arms, and at the base two smaller striated birds turned toward each other above paired feet.
anatolia_ppn_0174.notes_sonnet: A vertical carved column/pole divided into registers: a single large bird with spread wings at top, a middle band with two crossed-arm human figures wearing crosshatched garments, and at bottom a facing pair of smaller birds with beaks nearly touching, separated by plain undecorated bands.

anatolia_ppn_0175.title: Totem head. Nevalı Çori (8400-8100 BCE) Şanlıurfa - Archeology Museum, July 2025.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0175.notes: A weathered three-dimensional stone carving with vertically stacked forms: a large rounded upper mass bearing fanned incised parallel lines suggesting a wing or plumage, a middle head-like element with lattice hatching and a projecting snout-like piece, and below it a crouching limbed figure on a tapering base.
anatolia_ppn_0175.notes_sonnet: A stone sculpture depicting two stacked human-like heads/busts, the upper one with incised linear texture suggesting hair or headdress, the lower figure showing carved arms and hands clasped near the chest.

anatolia_ppn_0179.title: Urfa Gobeklitepe Building A sept 2019 5334.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0179.notes_sonnet: A carved stone pillar with a faint low-relief figure resembling a four-legged animal on its front face, surrounded by rubble.

anatolia_ppn_0186.title: Urfa Gobeklitepe Building B sept 2019 5332.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0186.notes_sonnet: A single low-relief carving of a lizard-like or reptilian creature with four limbs and a long curved tail/body is incised into a stone block, with a wooden measuring tool placed beside it for scale.

anatolia_ppn_0195.title: Urfa Gobeklitepe Building B sept 2019 5397.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0195.notes_sonnet: A single low-relief carving of a lizard-like reptile with a curved body and four limbs is carved into a stone slab, with modern wooden supports visible at the edge of the frame.

anatolia_ppn_0196.title: Urfa Gobeklitepe Building B sept 2019 5398.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0196.notes_sonnet: An excavation site showing carved stone pillars, one bearing a faint low-relief animal figure near its top, with a separate carved stone block featuring a raised ring/disc motif set among rubble and measuring rods.

anatolia_ppn_0199.title: Urfa Göbeklitepe Building A 5336.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0199.notes: A tall T-shaped upright stone slab carries low relief: an upper plain band with a raised edge, below which are one or two four-legged animals in profile and a lower elongated crawling creature with splayed limbs.
anatolia_ppn_0199.notes_sonnet: A worked stone slab set upright shows a single low-relief carving of a four-legged animal near its lower-middle section, with the surface otherwise plain.

anatolia_ppn_0205.title: Urfa Göbeklitepe Building A sept 2019 5403.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0205.notes: A tall upright stone slab with a broad upper projection carries a low-relief profile four-legged animal with a curving tail across the middle, above a fainter vertical elongated form lower down.
anatolia_ppn_0205.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a single four-legged animal in profile with curved horns or tail-like appendages, set against a plain upper band.

anatolia_ppn_0207.title: Urfa Göbeklitepe Building A sept 2019 5406.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0207.notes: A large four-legged animal in profile with a lowered head, curved tail and stiff legs is carved in low relief across the broad face of an upright stone block, with a fainter worn carving lower right.
anatolia_ppn_0207.notes_sonnet: A single four-legged animal with curved horns or tusks is carved in low relief on a stone slab set among rubble.

anatolia_ppn_0212.title: Urfa Göbeklitepe Building B 5396.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0212.notes: A single low-relief animal with a strongly arched elongated back, angular bent limbs and a blunt head oriented to the upper right occupies the middle of an otherwise plain stone slab surface.
anatolia_ppn_0212.notes_sonnet: A single carved outline of a four-legged animal with a curved back and raised tail occupies the lower stone slab, with no other visible imagery.

anatolia_ppn_0218.title: Urfa museum Fragment of stone vessel Nevalı Çori - Neolithic age 4795.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0218.notes_sonnet: A carved stone fragment shows several human figures clustered together with raised arms, possibly grappling or interacting, against a plain background with no other iconographic elements visible.

anatolia_ppn_0222.title: Urfa museum Head plus gear - Nevali Çori - Neolithic age - 4857.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0222.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone carving of a human head and upper block, showing eyes, nose, and mouth roughly rendered, mounted on a plain pedestal.

anatolia_ppn_0223.title: Urfa museum Head with snake Nevalı Çori - Neolithic age - 4859.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0223.notes: A single carved stone figure with a rounded frontal head bearing two deep eye hollows and a projecting beak-like ridge, with stubby arm-like projections at the sides and a broken lower body mounted on a plain plaster base.
anatolia_ppn_0223.notes_sonnet: A rounded, worn stone form with two carved recessed hollows suggesting eyes and a vertical incised line down the center, mounted upright on a plain base, with no clear figural imagery discernible.

anatolia_ppn_0232.title: Urfa museum Karahantepe Head of Leopard Neolithic age in 2024 7319.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0232.notes_sonnet: A weathered, roughly carved stone fragment shows a blocky, textured head-like form with deep grooves suggesting stacked ridges or teeth-like bands across its lower portion, mounted on a display stand.

anatolia_ppn_0239.title: Urfa museum Karahantepe Human statue Neolithic Age in 2024 7359.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0239.notes: A tall, roughly carved stone pillar-figure with a large frontal head showing brow ridges, eyes, nose and mouth above a columnar body with faint arm indications.
anatolia_ppn_0239.notes_sonnet: A weathered, roughly carved standing stone figure with a distinct head bearing eyes, nose and mouth, and a columnar body with no clearly defined limbs.

anatolia_ppn_0240.title: Urfa museum Karahantepe Human statue Neolithic Age in 2024 7360.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0240.notes: A coarse, porous stone head carved in the round with heavy brow ridges, deep-set eye hollows, a long prominent nose and a broad mouth, tapering into a neck/body block below.
anatolia_ppn_0240.notes_sonnet: A close-up of a weathered, porous stone head/face with roughly carved features (brow, nose, cheeks) and no additional decorative motifs visible on the surface.

anatolia_ppn_0241.title: Urfa museum Karahantepe Human statue Neolithic Age in 2025 9272.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0241.notes_sonnet: A weathered, roughly carved stone figure showing a head with facial features atop a worn, columnar body, displayed upright on a pedestal.

anatolia_ppn_0244.title: Urfa museum Karahantepe Human statue head Neolithic Age in 2024 7370.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0244.notes: Weathered stone block carved in the round with rounded ridges suggesting an animal head with a snout, brow and eye socket, the rest of the surface eroded and featureless.
anatolia_ppn_0244.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone carving showing a curved, ram-like horned animal head in relief, mounted on a display stand against a blurred background.

anatolia_ppn_0247.title: Urfa museum Karahantepe Human statue head Neolithic Age in 2024 7374.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0247.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone carving shows two adjoining human-like heads with simple facial features atop a shared torso, encrusted with a light mineral coating.

anatolia_ppn_0259.title: Urfa museum Totemlike head - Nevalı Çori - Neolithic age 4891.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0259.notes: A weathered stone sculpture carved in the round showing a crouching animal-like figure with a large-eyed, snouted head and bent forelimbs, its neck and back covered with incised lattice and hatched patterning, with a further patterned carved block above it.
anatolia_ppn_0259.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface shows at least two human heads/figures with incised hatched patterns on hair or headdress, stacked vertically, with a small carved glyph-like mark and cracked, weathered stone texture.

anatolia_ppn_0260.title: Urfa museum Totemlike head - Nevalı Çori - Neolithic age 4892.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0260.notes: Close view of a large carved stone head with deep-set hollow eyes and a broad nose, its cranium and the adjoining block covered with finely incised crosshatch/lattice patterning.
anatolia_ppn_0260.notes_sonnet: A weathered carved stone surface shows a large face-like form with deep-set hollow eyes and mouth, topped by an area of fine cross-hatched incised pattern, with a second carved stone element visible behind/beside it bearing faint linear marks.

anatolia_ppn_0261.title: Urfa museum Totemlike head - Nevalı Çori - Neolithic age 4893.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0261.notes: A vertical carved stone pillar with stacked frontal human-like heads and torsos, the uppermost bearing a band of parallel incised lines and the central head topped by a fine lattice/hatched pattern.
anatolia_ppn_0261.notes_sonnet: A carved column-like form shows a stylized human face and upper body with arms drawn to the torso, topped by a separate band with a triangular incised lattice pattern above.

anatolia_ppn_0263.title: Urfa museum Totemlike head sept 2019 4855.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0263.notes: A weathered three-dimensional stone block carved with two stacked animal-like creatures, the upper one a large rounded head with deep incised ridges and the lower one crouching with a cross-hatched lattice-textured body and folded limbs.
anatolia_ppn_0263.notes_sonnet: A carved stone figure with a crouching human-like face and body at the bottom, topped by a larger rounded mass bearing incised diagonal line patterns, mounted on a pedestal-like base.

anatolia_ppn_0264.title: Urfa museum Totemlike head sept 2019 4858.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0264.notes: A vertical carved stone pillar with two stacked frontal head-and-shoulder figures, the upper one showing a wide row of bared teeth and the lower a rounded face with hollowed eyes, incised crosshatching on the brow, and arms folded onto the body.
anatolia_ppn_0264.notes_sonnet: A carved stone figure with a large rectangular upper section bearing a striped/serrated band, sitting above a rounded head with carved facial features and a body with arms folded, the whole object mounted upright on a pedestal.

anatolia_ppn_0266.title: Urfa museum Totemlike head sept 2019 4890.jpg

anatolia_ppn_0266.notes_sonnet: A carved stone figure with a bird-like head (beak, feathered texture) atop a human-form body, with a rectangular incised glyph block visible beside the head.

anatolia_ppn_0267.title: Urfa museum Totemlike head sept 2019 4895.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0267.notes: A tall carved stone pillar-like sculpture with a large frontal face in high relief in the middle, a partly broken similar head above it, incised cross-hatched lattice patterning over the crown areas, and rounded limb-like projections lower down.
anatolia_ppn_0267.notes_sonnet: A carved stone form shows a roughly symmetrical human-like face with incised eyes, nose and mouth, set below a band of cross-hatched (lattice) texture, with a rounded torso-like mass beneath bearing shallow carved marks.

anatolia_ppn_0270.title: Vogelmenschenrelief.Kalkstein.Goebeklitepe.MNR.23450.P1067712.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0270.notes: A tall, weathered upright stone block carved in low relief with a roughly symmetrical schematic face or figure: a raised vertical ridge like a nose, two sunken hollows resembling eyes, and a shallow arched groove above.
anatolia_ppn_0270.notes_sonnet: A roughly symmetrical carved stone block with two deep hollow sockets suggesting eyes and a raised vertical ridge suggesting a nose, but the surface is heavily weathered with no clear figurative imagery discernible.

anatolia_ppn_0272.title: Vulture Stone, Gobekli Tepe, Sanliurfa, South-east Anatolia, Turkey.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0272.notes: A rectangular stone face carved in low relief with an upper row of three arched, handle-like rectangular objects, a middle band of repeated hatched zigzag/comb pattern, and a lower zone with several long-necked profile creatures, a rounded-headed animal and a small circular shape.
anatolia_ppn_0272.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows an upper band of repeated arch-like humps above a zigzag border, with a middle-lower zone containing an animal-headed or otherwise composite creature, a quadruped, a small disc-like shape, and a bird in profile near the bottom.

anatolia_ppn_0276.title: Şanlıurfa Müzesi Neotilik Çağ taş kase parçası.jpg
anatolia_ppn_0276.notes: A curved fragment of a vessel or plaque carved in fairly high relief with a row of several crouching or squatting figures with raised arms and rounded heads, arranged in a single continuous band.
anatolia_ppn_0276.notes_sonnet: A worn stone relief fragment shows a row of several human figures in active poses, with hands raised and one figure appearing to grasp another, suggesting a scene of physical interaction or struggle.

catalhoyuk_0025.title: Chatal Hüyük, dancers with leopard skins, 6000 BC.jpg
catalhoyuk_0025.notes: A crowded scattered field of small dark stick-like human figures in active running, bending and gesturing poses, several holding thin sticks or curved objects, with dotted markings on hips and heads and a few isolated fragments of limbs.
catalhoyuk_0025.notes_sonnet: A crowded scene of numerous small dark silhouetted human figures in dynamic running, crouching and gesturing poses spread across two loose horizontal bands, many holding stick-like objects, with one quadruped figure and a few isolated white outlined figures among them.

catalhoyuk_0026.title: Detail of the mural showing the hind part of the aurochs, a deer and hunters..jpg
catalhoyuk_0026.notes: A cracked white plastered wall painted in red ochre, with a horizontal dark band separating an upper zone containing a radiating fan-like motif and partial limbs from a lower zone showing large profile four-legged animals in outline.
catalhoyuk_0026.notes_sonnet: A weathered rock surface divided by a horizontal crack into two zones, with faint red-brown pigment outlines of a four-legged animal and a slender upright figure in the lower band and indistinct abstract red marks in the upper band.

catalhoyuk_0031.title: Mural from Çatalhöyük excavated by James Mellaart showing neolithic hunters attacking an aurochs (Bos primigenius)..jpg
catalhoyuk_0031.notes: A cracked plastered wall surface bears a very large red-painted quadruped-like body filling the left portion, with several small dark stick-like human figures in active poses scattered across the right portion, all in a single unbanded field.
catalhoyuk_0031.notes_sonnet: A weathered rock surface with faint dark painted outlines suggestive of a bird-like figure and small human-like figures with a staff-like line, set against patches of red and white pigment and a natural hole in the stone.

catalhoyuk_0039.title: Restored copy of Çatalhöyük mural showing a boar and a deer surrounded by hunters..jpg
catalhoyuk_0039.notes: A large antlered quadruped dominates the upper area with a second horned quadruped lower right, surrounded by many small running red human figures, some with dotted sashes or animal-headed appearance, plus small carried objects and sticks.
catalhoyuk_0039.notes_sonnet: A large red antlered animal dominates the center of the composition, surrounded by numerous smaller running and gesturing human figures and a second, smaller four-legged animal, all rendered in a flat silhouette style on a plain background.

catalhoyuk_0065.title: Çatalhöyük 2008 DSC 0003 (2767648028).jpg
catalhoyuk_0065.notes: A low earthen wall face bears a horizontal band of repeated red-pigment motifs — rounded blotches and splayed finger-like marks — much faded and interrupted by cracks and holes, with photographic scale markers placed on the surface.
catalhoyuk_0065.notes_sonnet: An eroded mudbrick or earthen wall surface bears a horizontal band of faded red-orange pigment containing a repeating row of circular/disc-shaped motifs, with pockmarked erosion holes across the panel.

catalhoyuk_0102.title: Çatalhöyük, 7400 BC, Konya, Turkey - UNESCO World Heritage Site, 05.jpg
catalhoyuk_0102.notes: A pale plastered corner wall bears several narrow vertical panels of repeated dark red lattice/zigzag motifs, with a mounted horned animal skull and antlers set below and beside the painted field.
catalhoyuk_0102.notes_sonnet: An animal skull with horns is mounted on a plastered wall corner beside painted vertical bands of red zigzag/lattice patterns and dark glyph-like marks, with antlers and debris on the floor below.

catalhoyuk_0110.title: Çatalhöyük, 7400 BC, Konya, Turkey - UNESCO World Heritage Site, 13.jpg
catalhoyuk_0110.notes: A large flat painted panel in dark red on a grey ground showing one oversized antlered quadruped surrounded by many small lively stick-like human figures, several smaller bovine and canine animals, and scattered dotted leaf- or spotted-hide-like motifs, all in a single unbanded field.
catalhoyuk_0110.notes_sonnet: A long mural-like painted panel on a wall shows numerous small red and cream human figures in running or hunting poses interspersed with larger horned/antlered quadrupeds, a snake-like curved line, scattered dot/disc marks, and rows of small triangular geometric patterns near the bottom.

rapa_nui_0002.title: A Rock At Orongo Carved With Figures Of Bird-Men, The Mystery of Easter Island, published 1919.jpg
rapa_nui_0002.notes: Weathered high-relief carving on a boulder showing at least two large rounded heads with deep-set eyes and crouching bodies with visible hands, plus small ring-like discs beside them.
rapa_nui_0002.notes_sonnet: A heavily weathered stone relief shows a central human-like figure with an extended arm and hand, flanked by large disc or ring shapes and a possible bird-like head silhouette on one side, but surface erosion makes precise reading difficult.

rapa_nui_0004.title: Back side of Hoa Hakananai'a stone moai.jpg
rapa_nui_0004.notes: The rear surface of a tall standing stone figure carries shallow low-relief motifs: paired curved/hooked forms on the upper back, a prominent ring with an internal element at the centre, a multi-line band encircling the lower back with a vertical hooked element below it, and a small circular boss near the base.
rapa_nui_0004.notes_sonnet: A carved stone figure with a stylized head at top bearing fine incised linear marks, a raised circular disc motif on the chest/torso, and a curved horizontal band with parallel grooves near the lower torso, all set on an otherwise plain weathered stone surface.

rapa_nui_0005.title: Back view. Basalt statue, Hoa Hakananai'a (hidden or stolen friend). Moai; an ancestor figure, made by the Rapanui people. 1000-1200 CE. From Orongo (Polynesia, Easter Island); probably made in Rano Kao. British Museum.jpg
rapa_nui_0005.notes: The rear surface of a tall weathered monolithic stone figure bears shallow worn carvings: a ring/disc motif with a smaller circular element, curved lines and paired arcs sweeping across the lower body like a broad banded pattern, with a block-like upper element above.
rapa_nui_0005.notes_sonnet: A large carved stone figure with a blocky head bearing vertical ridge patterns, curved arched lines across the mid-section, and a circular disc motif carved into the chest area, with additional faint curvilinear carvings below.

rapa_nui_0006.title: Basalt Statue known as Hoa Hakananaia (front) - British Museum.jpg
rapa_nui_0006.notes: A large frontal stone figure carved in the round with a broad blocky head, deep-set brow and eye hollows, sloping shoulders, and a torso with modelled nipples and a rounded belly, photographed indoors.
rapa_nui_0006.notes_sonnet: A large carved stone humanoid figure with an elongated head, heavy brow, flat nose, protruding lips, defined neck, torso with nipples and arms at the sides, no other decorative motifs visible.

rapa_nui_0019.title: Chile-03352 - Petroglyphs (49072612868).jpg
rapa_nui_0019.notes: A weathered lichen-covered boulder bears shallow pecked curvilinear motifs, including concentric oval or spiral-like rings and arcing grooves, with no clearly identifiable figures.
rapa_nui_0019.notes_sonnet: A weathered boulder surface shows two faint concentric circular (spiral-like) motifs pecked into the stone amid natural grass and adjacent rocks.

rapa_nui_0021.title: Chile-03420 - Bird-man (49072590913).jpg
rapa_nui_0021.notes: A weathered, cracked stone block bears faint shallow-carved curving lines in raking light that suggest a large animal-like outline with legs, plus indistinct marks below.
rapa_nui_0021.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface shows a curved band with a raised ridge near the top and faint, shallow linear scratches or incisions across the lower portion that do not resolve into a clear figural motif.

rapa_nui_0022.title: Close up of the bird beaks.jpg
rapa_nui_0022.notes: The rear surface of a large stone figure carved in low relief with a band of vertical incised strokes at the top, two or three elongated tapering vertical motifs below it, and curving looped and ring-like elements spanning the lower body area, roughly symmetric about the vertical axis.
rapa_nui_0022.notes_sonnet: The back of a large carved stone head/bust shows a vertically symmetric arrangement of narrow elongated staff- or tool-like carved motifs across the upper portion, with looping band-like carved lines curving down over the shoulders below.

rapa_nui_0025.title: D050- Statue de l île de Paques -dos- -L1-Ch1.png
rapa_nui_0025.notes: A worn, roughly symmetrical stone figure carved in the round, its upper block bearing vertical grooved elements and its chest decorated in low relief with looping strands, small bosses, a prominent plain ring on the torso, and parallel belt-like lines above a plain lower body.
rapa_nui_0025.notes_sonnet: A carved stone figure with snake-like branching lines descending from the head/neck area, a plain circular disc carved on the torso, and a curved band with hatching near the base.

rapa_nui_0034.title: Flickr - Nic's events - London - 14-15 Dec 2007 - 176.jpg
rapa_nui_0034.notes: A tall upright stone figure with a large blocky head and elongated features, its torso bearing shallow carved rings and circular motifs plus paired incised lines forming a belt-like band lower down; photographed from below in a gallery.
rapa_nui_0034.notes_sonnet: A large carved stone figure's back/torso shows a raised circular disc motif flanked by curved incised lines above it and a banded horizontal groove pattern below, all on a weathered stone surface.

rapa_nui_0039.title: Hoa Hakananai'a - Moai from Easter Island - Joy of Museums - 2.jpg
rapa_nui_0039.notes: The rear surface of a large monolithic carved block bears shallow relief motifs including a prominent ring or disc, paired curved shapes above it, and long arcing bands sweeping across the lower body with a vertical element below.
rapa_nui_0039.notes_sonnet: The back of a large stone figure is carved in low relief with a prominent central ring or disc, an arched curved line beneath it, and softly rounded raised forms above resembling clasped or overlapping shapes, the whole design roughly symmetric about a vertical axis.

rapa_nui_0044.title: Hoa Hakananai'a 2.jpg
rapa_nui_0044.notes: The rear surface of a large weathered stone monolith bears shallow relief carving: a pair of small circles or rings flanking the upper back, a larger concentric ring with radiating interior lines at the centre, and below them several parallel curving bands running around the body with a further looped/curved motif beneath.
rapa_nui_0044.notes_sonnet: A large carved stone form (back view) with a central raised disc surrounded by curving abstract motifs on the upper back, and a horizontal curved band with a triangular element below it near the base.

rapa_nui_0045.title: Hoa Hakananai'a 3.jpg
rapa_nui_0045.notes: The rear surface of a tall monolithic stone figure carries shallow, weathered relief motifs: a central ring or disc, paired arcing curved lines sweeping outward beneath it, faint symmetrical shapes above, and a smaller circular boss lower down.
rapa_nui_0045.notes_sonnet: A large upright carved stone monolith with a smooth rounded top and a lower decorated zone showing a central circular motif flanked by symmetrical curved carved lines and a horizontal banded arc beneath it.

rapa_nui_0046.title: Hoa Hakananai'a 4.jpg
rapa_nui_0046.notes: Weathered stone monolith with low-relief carvings on its broad rear face: paired ring and circular motifs near the top, a prominent raised ring in the middle, and below it a long double-curved arc spanning the width with vertical tapering shapes hanging beneath it.
rapa_nui_0046.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface shows a symmetrical arrangement of curving relief bands, a central plain disc, and a large arched band motif with vertical striations below it.

rapa_nui_0047.title: Hoa Hakananai'a 5.jpg
rapa_nui_0047.notes: Tall monolithic stone figure seen from the rear, with a blocky head and shoulders above and shallow weathered low-relief motifs on the back: paired curvilinear forms near the upper back, a ringed circular motif with a small central disc in the middle, and long curved parallel bands sweeping across the lower body above a small round boss.
rapa_nui_0047.notes_sonnet: A tall carved monolith with an abstract face-like upper section, a circular disc motif in the middle of the torso, and a curved band with faint linear patterning near the base.

rapa_nui_0049.title: Hoa Hakananai'a back.jpg
rapa_nui_0049.notes: The rear surface of a large dark stone figure bears very shallow worn carving: faint curvilinear motifs across the shoulders, a prominent ring-like circle at the center of the lower back, and several parallel arcing lines forming a band beneath it.
rapa_nui_0049.notes_sonnet: A large stone monolith with a stylized head shape at top and carved relief on the body featuring vertical grooves, curling scroll-like motifs, a central raised disc, and a curved band beneath it.

rapa_nui_0052.title: Hoa Hakananai'a rear left shoulder.jpg
rapa_nui_0052.notes: Close view of a heavily weathered rounded stone surface bearing shallow low-relief curvilinear carving, including several roughly circular or oval elements and connecting curved ridges, too eroded for further definition.
rapa_nui_0052.notes_sonnet: Weathered stone surface with a raised rounded boss, faint curvilinear carved lines, and a distinct circular disc motif in the lower right area.

rapa_nui_0053.title: Hoa Hakananai'a rear of head.jpg
rapa_nui_0053.notes: A heavily eroded coarse stone block, apparently the shoulder/back area of a carved figure, bearing faint shallow relief signs arranged in vertical and horizontal groupings that read as glyph-like blocks.
rapa_nui_0053.notes_sonnet: Heavily weathered stone surface with two faint vertical elongated incised figures, each showing a horizontal bar near the top suggesting outstretched arms, with no clearly visible heads.

rapa_nui_0054.title: Hoa Hakananai'a rear view.jpg
rapa_nui_0054.notes: The rear surface of a tall monolithic stone figure bears shallow carvings: vertical grooved and hatched panels across the upper block, a pair of ring-and-crescent motifs flanking a larger central ring, and long curved arc lines with short vertical strokes below them.
rapa_nui_0054.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone surface with abstract vertical and curving line patterns at the top, a pair of raised almond-shaped forms flanking a central circular disc in the middle, and a horizontal ridge or band below it, with the lower portion left plain.

rapa_nui_0062.title: Hoa Hakananaia, Oc,G.T.1736, British Museum.jpg
rapa_nui_0062.notes: A worn, roughly symmetrical standing stone figure with an eroded head framed by a striated, chevron-patterned covering, and low-relief details on the torso including looping cords, pendant shapes, a prominent central ring, and horizontal banded lines low on the body.
rapa_nui_0062.notes_sonnet: A carved stone block/statue-like form with a headdress-like pattern at top, vertical linear elements below, a central oval/disc motif on the torso, and a horizontal band with triangular motifs near the base.

rapa_nui_0063.title: Hoa hakananai.jpg
rapa_nui_0063.notes: A large frontal stone figure carved in the round with a broad blocky head, deep-set brow and eye hollows, projecting nose, thin lips, and a torso with nipples and arms held close along the sides ending in hands near the lower body.
rapa_nui_0063.notes_sonnet: A large monolithic carved stone figure with an elongated head, heavy brow, prominent nose, pursed lips, and a torso showing stylized chest and arms resting at the sides.

rapa_nui_0065.title: Hoa hanakai dall'isola di pasqua, retrom 1400 circa.JPG
rapa_nui_0065.notes: Rear surface of a large weathered stone figure carved in shallow relief with a central ring or disc motif, paired curved loop shapes above it, and horizontal banded lines encircling the lower body with a vertical element beneath.
rapa_nui_0065.notes_sonnet: A large carved stone figure viewed from behind, showing a central raised disc/circle motif flanked by two rounded protrusions, with a horizontal band of parallel curved lines below it, all carved in low relief on the statue's surface.

rapa_nui_0069.title: Lower Back of Hoa Hakananai'a.jpg
rapa_nui_0069.notes: Lower part of a shaped stone block with shallow relief: concentric ring motifs near the top, a broad double-lined arc curving across the middle, and faint eroded linear marks below, with no clearly identifiable figures.
rapa_nui_0069.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface shows a plain circular disc near the top, above a curved band of parallel arcing lines, with a faint forked or branch-like incised mark below on the lower portion of the stone.

rapa_nui_0070.title: Makemake.jpeg
rapa_nui_0070.notes: A rounded boulder in grass bears weathered pecked/carved curvilinear grooves, including rounded concentric hollows and ridged spiral-like forms spread over the upper surface, too eroded to resolve distinct figures.
rapa_nui_0070.notes_sonnet: A large weathered boulder shows carved curvilinear grooves including a prominent spiral or ring-like motif near the upper right and flowing linear channels across the surface, but the eroded state makes specific figures hard to distinguish.

rapa_nui_0071.title: Makemake.jpg
rapa_nui_0071.notes: A weathered boulder surface carved in shallow relief with curved grooves forming rounded, ring-like and oval shapes with a vertical connecting ridge, partly eroded and lichen-covered.
rapa_nui_0071.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface bears a carved motif of two nested spiral or circular shapes connected by a curving line, set into an otherwise rough textured rock face.

rapa_nui_0073.title: Mata Nga Rahu, Orongo.jpg
rapa_nui_0073.notes: A weathered coastal boulder bears low-relief carvings of several crouching figures with elongated beaked heads arranged in a crowded field, interspersed with concentric circle and spiral motifs, overlooking water with islets.
rapa_nui_0073.notes_sonnet: A large boulder in the foreground is pecked with curvilinear, snake-like or spiral motifs and a distinct circular spiral shape, overlooking a deep blue ocean with a small rocky islet and a sea stack in the background.

rapa_nui_0079.title: Motu Nui.jpg
rapa_nui_0079.notes: Weathered boulder surfaces carved in low relief with several crouching profile figures having long beaked heads, curved backs and spiral-like body elements, set above open water with an offshore islet in the background.
rapa_nui_0079.notes_sonnet: A large volcanic boulder in the foreground bears faint curved incised or pecked lines that may form an abstract pattern, overlooking an ocean scene with a small rocky islet in the distance.

rapa_nui_0080.title: Oc,B102.35, Mana Expedition to Easter Island, British Museum.jpg
rapa_nui_0080.notes: A weathered boulder bearing low relief carving with a large circular/oval motif at center, an adjacent rounded head-like form with a prominent eye and curved projection at right, and limb-like elements with digits along the lower edge.
rapa_nui_0080.notes_sonnet: A pecked outline of a bird-like creature in profile with a coiled or spiral circular motif near its body is carved into the rough stone surface.

rapa_nui_0082.title: Oc,G.T.1483, Mana Expedition to Easter Island, British Museum.jpg
rapa_nui_0082.notes: An upright rectangular stone block bears a single shallow-carved frontal face with brow, eyes, nose and mouth in its middle zone, the rest of the surface left plain and rough.
rapa_nui_0082.notes_sonnet: A carved stone head/pillar with a simple incised face sits on a larger rough boulder, next to a living man sitting with arms crossed in a grassy, rocky landscape.

rapa_nui_0096.title: Orongo - Easter Island (3844717859).jpg
rapa_nui_0096.notes: Two adjacent weathered boulders bear deeply carved curvilinear animal-like figures in profile with rounded heads, circular eye motifs and clawed limbs, plus scattered drilled pits.
rapa_nui_0096.notes_sonnet: A large stone surface bears two carved, elongated sinuous forms resembling serpents with curled or coiled ends, each accompanied by a small circular disc-like motif near their heads, set against a weathered rocky background with some vegetation at the edges.

rapa_nui_0097.title: Orongo - Easter Island (3844717971).jpg
rapa_nui_0097.notes: A single large curvilinear creature-like figure with a rounded head and eye is carved in low relief into a weathered outcrop, surrounded by grass and bare stone.
rapa_nui_0097.notes_sonnet: A single carved motif resembling a bird in profile with a curved neck and beak is incised into the weathered stone surface, surrounded by cracks and natural rock texture.

rapa_nui_0099.title: Orongo - Easter Island (3845509088).jpg
rapa_nui_0099.notes: A weathered boulder in an outdoor rocky setting bears faint shallow pecked curvilinear markings, including two rounded concentric depressions and adjoining grooves, across the middle of its upper face.
rapa_nui_0099.notes_sonnet: A large weathered boulder near water shows a faint pecked or carved circular motif with some curving lines around it, but the carving is shallow and eroded, making details hard to discern.

rapa_nui_0100.title: Orongo - Easter Island (3845509218).jpg
rapa_nui_0100.notes: Weathered boulder surfaces bearing shallow pecked/incised outlines of four-legged animals in profile, with one large horned-looking creature on the lower rock and smaller ones plus a spiral-like circular motif on adjacent stones.
rapa_nui_0100.notes_sonnet: Weathered rock surface with faint pecked or incised markings including a small circular motif and indistinct curvilinear lines, surrounded by natural rock texture and vegetation.

rapa_nui_0101.title: Orongo - Easter Island (3845509290).jpg
rapa_nui_0101.notes: A large boulder bears a raised-relief crouching figure with a beaked head and prominent round eye, with a row of short parallel ridges (comb-like) across the middle of the body; a second weathered boulder to the right carries a similar carved figure.
rapa_nui_0101.notes_sonnet: A large boulder shows a pecked spiral/disc motif near the top and a horizontal band of parallel vertical striations below it, with additional carved shapes visible on adjacent rocks.

rapa_nui_0103.title: Orongo - Easter Island (3869415565).jpg
rapa_nui_0103.notes: Weathered boulders bear low-relief carvings, the largest showing a broad face-like design with two large round concentric eyes and a spiral motif, with further eroded face-like reliefs on the rocks behind.
rapa_nui_0103.notes_sonnet: A large boulder in the foreground bears pecked concentric circular motifs connected by curving lines, set among other large rocks with faint carved shapes near a coastline.

rapa_nui_0106.title: PETROGLYPHS ON THE ROCKS NEAR ORONGO VILLAGE - EASTER ISLAND.jpg
rapa_nui_0106.notes: A weathered outcrop of large stone blocks bears shallow relief carvings, with a row of crouching profile figures having large beaked or elongated heads along the upper block and fainter, heavily eroded curvilinear motifs on the lower block.
rapa_nui_0106.notes_sonnet: Weathered rock surface with shallow pecked or eroded abstract markings and small circular depressions, no clear figurative forms discernible.

rapa_nui_0108.title: Petroglifos de Orongo.JPG
rapa_nui_0108.notes: A weathered boulder overlooking open sea bears several pecked, low-relief crouching figures with elongated beaked heads and curled limbs, arranged in loose stacked rows, with a couple of concentric circular motifs carved lower on the rock face.
rapa_nui_0108.notes_sonnet: A pecked stone surface in the foreground shows several overlapping circular and curvilinear motifs, with a rocky coastline and sea visible in the background.

rapa_nui_0109.title: Petroglifos en Orongo I.jpg
rapa_nui_0109.notes: Weathered basalt boulders on a grassy coastal edge bear low-relief curvilinear carvings, the clearest being a crouching profile figure with a curved beak-like head and spiral-like body lines on the foreground rock.
rapa_nui_0109.notes_sonnet: A weathered boulder in the foreground bears a single shallow, curving incised or pecked line resembling a simple sinuous shape, set against grass and a hazy sea horizon, with no other clear figurative carvings visible.

rapa_nui_0111.title: Petroglifos en Orongo III.jpg
rapa_nui_0111.notes: Weathered boulders carved in low relief with several crouching profile figures bearing large round eyes and long curved beak-like heads, repeated across adjacent rock faces in a single unbanded field.
rapa_nui_0111.notes_sonnet: A large weathered boulder/statue surface shows faint carved spiral and curvilinear motifs along with a lower band of short parallel incised lines, but the eroded stone makes precise identification of forms difficult.

rapa_nui_0113.title: Petroglyphs on the back of the Hoa Hakananai'a Statue.jpg
rapa_nui_0113.notes: The rear surface of a tall carved stone block bears shallow relief: vertical striped panels across the upper slab, paired curved crescent forms flanking a central ring with a smaller inner circle, and broad arcing lines sweeping across the lower body, arranged roughly symmetrically about a vertical axis.
rapa_nui_0113.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone slab with vertical bands of abstract incised marks near the top, a raised circular disc in the middle flanked by curved arcs, and a curved band motif lower down, all rendered in shallow relief on a weathered rock surface.

rapa_nui_0122.title: Stone Exhumed From Orongo, 1914. Bird-man in low relief with egg in hand. Length of carving, 36.5 cm. British Museum, The Mystery of Easter Island, published 1919.jpg
rapa_nui_0122.notes: A single crouching four-legged animal figure carved in the round from pale stone, shown in profile against a dark background, filling nearly the whole frame.
rapa_nui_0122.notes_sonnet: A worn, rounded carved surface shows a bulky four-legged animal form with a small circular eye-like feature near the head end, rendered in high-contrast light and shadow suggesting relief carving on stone.

rapa_nui_0124.title: View of an in relief carving of three birdman figures; Mata Ngarau, Oc,G.T.1647, Mana Expedition to Easter Island, British Museum.jpg
rapa_nui_0124.notes: A heavily weathered, lichen-covered stone block carved in low relief with a row of three crouching anthropomorphic figures, one showing a splayed hand with fingers and a curled ring-like motif beside it at the right.
rapa_nui_0124.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone relief shows a row of at least three similarly posed crouching figures with rounded bird-like heads and human-like bodies, each accompanied by a small circular disc motif near the torso.

rapa_nui_0128.title: “Ludzie - ptaki”- ryty naskalne z haczykowatym nosem - Wieś Oronga - 002003s.jpg
rapa_nui_0128.notes: A cluster of large boulders covered with pecked curvilinear motifs — spirals, concentric circles, mask-like faces and one four-legged animal-like form — photographed with two people present for scale, one seated among the rocks and one standing at upper left.
rapa_nui_0128.notes_sonnet: A photograph shows large boulders covered with pecked carvings including a horned quadruped, circular/spiral motifs, and abstract geometric patterns, with two living people (one in modern clothing) posed among the rocks for scale.

assyria_0000.title: 2. Alabaster bas-relief from the North-West Palace of Ashurnasirpal II at Nimrud, Iraq. 9th century BCE. National Museum of Scotland. Donated by Sir Dr. James Young.jpg
assyria_0000.notes: A large stone slab carved in low relief shows a large bearded standing figure raising a shallow bowl and wearing a sheathed blade at the waist, with a smaller attendant figure behind, patterned fringed garment borders, and rows of small inscribed signs across the lower half.
assyria_0000.notes_sonnet: A large stone relief slab shows two robed human figures in profile facing each other, the larger one holding a curved staff or weapon and a small round object, with a band of incised script running along the lower portion of the panel.

assyria_0008.title: Alabaster bas-relief from the North-West Palace of Ashurnasirpal II at Nimrud, Iraq. 9th century BCE. National Museum of Scotland. Donated by Sir Dr. James Young.jpg
assyria_0008.notes: Two robed human figures in profile face one another, one holding a curved bow and the other raising a shallow bowl with a dagger at his waist, with dense rows of small script signs carved across their garments and patterned hem borders.
assyria_0008.notes_sonnet: Two robed standing figures face each other, one raising a curved object and the other holding a shallow bowl, with a band of small script across the lower-middle field and a decorative border at the base.

persepolis_0080.title: Relief on the southern wall of the east stairway of the Apadana depicting Syrians who bring a pair of bowls, a bar of copper in the shape of an animal skin, and a garment, Persepolis, Iran (40897094353).jpg
persepolis_0080.notes: A single band of carved stone relief showing a procession of five bearded, robed figures in profile facing right, several holding bowl- or vessel-like objects, with a taller figure at the right holding a slender staff and turning back toward them.
persepolis_0080.notes_sonnet: A row of standing robed human figures in profile, most holding cup-like vessels, filing toward a figure at the right who holds a staff and clasps hands with the nearest figure.

persepolis_0082.title: Relieffries in Persepolis.jpg
persepolis_0082.notes: A carved stone relief panel bordered top and bottom by bands of repeated rosettes, showing a procession of standing men in profile with caps, a stylised conifer-like tree, and two horned quadrupeds led by attendants.
persepolis_0082.notes_sonnet: A carved stone frieze shows a row of standing human figures holding hands or a staff near a stylized tree on the left, while two figures lead two horned animals by ropes on the right, framed above and below by bands of repeated rosette patterns.

persepolis_0084.title: Reliefs in Persepolis نگاره های تخت جمشید 12.jpg
persepolis_0084.notes: Carved stone relief showing three bearded figures in profile moving rightward, two leading a pair of curly-fleeced horned quadrupeds, with the rightmost figure holding a shallow handled object; a vertical joint line divides the slab.
persepolis_0084.notes_sonnet: A stone relief shows a procession of three robed human figures leading horned, fleece-covered animals, with a rightmost figure holding a rod and a rounded object.

persepolis_0085.title: Reliefs in Persepolis نگاره های تخت جمشید 13.jpg
persepolis_0085.notes: Two overlapping horned quadruped heads in right-facing profile, their bodies covered with dense repeated curl patterning, carved in low relief on stone.
persepolis_0085.notes_sonnet: A carved stone relief shows two curly-horned ram or sheep heads with detailed fleece texture, positioned side by side facing the same direction.

persepolis_0087.title: Reliefs in Persepolis نگاره های تخت جمشید 20.jpg
persepolis_0087.notes: A carved stone relief showing a row of bearded robed figures in profile walking to the right, several holding small blossom-like objects and carrying rounded pouch or quiver-like containers, with a repeating floral ornamental border along the bottom edge and a narrow patterned band at the top.
persepolis_0087.notes_sonnet: A row of five standing robed figures wearing tall fluted headdresses, holding hands or exchanging small objects, with a flower-shaped border band below.

persepolis_0088.title: Reliefs in Persepolis نگاره های تخت جمشید 21.jpg
persepolis_0088.notes: A carved stone relief shows a standing figure in a two-wheeled wheeled vehicle drawn by harnessed hoofed animals moving left, with a rosette border band along the lower edge and a spoked wheel at right.
persepolis_0088.notes_sonnet: A carved stone relief shows a horse pulling a two-wheeled chariot driven by a standing figure holding reins and a long staff, with another figure walking beside the horse, above a lower border of large spoked wheel and a floral/rosette geometric band.

persepolis_0089.title: Reliefs in Persepolis نگاره های تخت جمشید 22.jpg
persepolis_0089.notes: A shallow carved stone panel showing a bearded figure in profile holding the bridled head and reins of a large maned four-legged animal whose body and legs extend across the block, with cracks and a horizontal joint crossing the surface.
persepolis_0089.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone relief shows a standing human figure in profile holding a rope or rein attached to a large horse-like quadruped, with a decorative curved element behind the horse's head, all carved in shallow relief with visible cracking of the stone surface.

persepolis_0093.title: Ruins of Persepolis 14.jpeg
persepolis_0093.notes: A long carved stone wall in shallow relief shows stacked horizontal bands of processing robed figures leading horned animals and carrying staffs and vessels, separated by rosette borders, with stylized conical trees interspersed.
persepolis_0093.notes_sonnet: A stone wall carved in two horizontal registers showing rows of human figures in procession, some leading animals with curved horns, interspersed with a tall stylized tree, staffs held by figures, and narrow decorative bands separating the registers.

persepolis_0095.title: Shiraz-09040.jpg
persepolis_0095.notes: Two curl-horned, densely fleeced quadrupeds walk in profile to the right, their bodies covered with repeated spiral-curl patterning, while above and behind them are the partly preserved arms and legs of a human figure whose head is outside the visible field.
persepolis_0095.notes_sonnet: Two large curved-horn animals with textured fleece walk in profile, each with a human hand or arm resting on its back, carved in stone relief.

persepolis_0097.title: Sogdian Tribute Bearers on the Apadana Staircase 16 (Best Viewed Size "Large") (4689076272).jpg
persepolis_0097.artist: A.Davey from Portland, Oregon, EE UU
persepolis_0097.notes: A carved stone relief showing a file of six long-robed bearded figures walking in profile to the left, several holding bowls or fluted vessels, with a leafy plant at the right edge, a partial animal head at the far left, and a continuous band of repeated rosettes along the bottom.
persepolis_0097.notes_sonnet: A row of standing robed human figures in profile, most carrying bowls or containers, walking in single file toward a larger figure at the right who holds a staff, with a small animal head at the far left edge, a stylized tree at the far right, and a band of rosette-like geometric motifs along the bottom.

persepolis_0099.title: Takht e Jamshid 02.jpg
persepolis_0099.notes: A long stone wall carved in low relief shows stacked horizontal bands of processing robed human figures carrying handled vessels, separated by a band of repeated rosettes, with a large animal head at left and stylised trees between groups.
persepolis_0099.notes_sonnet: A carved stone wall shows an upper register of standing robed figures above a floral-patterned band, and a lower register with a large animal head and neck at left followed by a procession of robed human figures, some holding cups, a staff, and a small plant motif, with additional figures continuing into the distance at right.

persepolis_0100.title: Tribute of Rams, Persepolis, Iran (14288410559).jpg
persepolis_0100.artist: Julia Maudlin from Lake Oswego, Oregon, USA
persepolis_0100.notes: Carved stone relief showing a procession of profile human figures in patterned caps leading two large horned, fleece-textured quadrupeds rightward, with a foliage motif at left, a handled object at right, and a rosette-patterned border along the bottom edge.
persepolis_0100.notes_sonnet: A stone relief shows a line of robed human figures walking in profile leading two large horned animals (rams) by hand, with a decorative plant motif at left and a repeating floral/geometric band along the bottom edge.

persepolis_0104.title: Wall of stairs panorama in Persepolis c1.jpg
persepolis_0104.notes: A curved stone wall carved in low relief with three stacked horizontal bands of processing figures in caps and robes leading humped and horned animals, carrying vessels and staffs, separated by rosette-patterned dividing strips with stylized trees interspersed.
persepolis_0104.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone relief carved in three stacked horizontal registers, each showing rows of standing human figures in long robes and headgear, some leading animals, interspersed with narrow decorative bands of repeated rosette-like patterns and flanked by stylized tree or plant forms in the lowest register.

persepolis_0105.title: تخت جمشید با عظمت 47.jpg
persepolis_0105.notes: A carved stone panel with a narrow upper band of repeated rosette motifs above a row of robed, bearded human figures in profile carrying shallow bowls, advancing toward a taller figure at the right who turns to face them and holds a long staff-like object.
persepolis_0105.notes_sonnet: A row of standing robed figures in profile, most holding small bowls or cups, with one larger figure at the right holding a staff, all beneath a decorative border of repeated rosette motifs.

persepolis_0108.title: تخت جمشید17.jpg
persepolis_0108.notes: A carved stone relief showing a procession of bearded figures in patterned headgear moving in one direction, leading two large horned, curly-fleeced animals shown in profile, with a narrow ornamental border along the lower edge.
persepolis_0108.notes_sonnet: A carved stone relief shows a row of robed human figures with elaborately patterned headgear leading two curly-horned rams that face each other head to head.

persepolis_0110.title: عکس حکاکی شده قوچ، تخت جمشید، شیراز.jpg
persepolis_0110.notes: Close view of a carved stone relief showing the head and shoulder of a horned, curly-fleeced quadruped in profile, its body covered with dense repeated spiral and striated tufts forming an allover patterned field.
persepolis_0110.notes_sonnet: A close-up carved relief of a horned animal's head and curled horn with a textured, wavy-patterned coat covering its body and neck.

egypt_0000.title: Akhenaten and the his family worshipping the Aten.jpg
egypt_0000.notes: A carved relief showing a large rayed disc at top whose radiating lines end near two tall striding figures with tall headgear, followed by smaller figures, all facing a laden offering table stacked with goods and rows of vessels, framed by columns of glyph blocks and a continuous glyph band along the bottom.
egypt_0000.notes_sonnet: A carved wall panel shows a radiant disc at top with rays ending in hands, dense columns of glyphs to the left and above, and below a row of standing human figures beside a table laden with rounded vessels.

egypt_0002.title: Amarna Grenzstele U 02.jpg
egypt_0002.notes: A tall weathered stone wall panel carved with many horizontal lines of small glyph signs, heavily eroded in the lower half, with fragmentary carved figure forms visible at the far left and right edges.
egypt_0002.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface bearing multiple horizontal lines of small carved script or glyph blocks, with the lower portion badly eroded and illegible.

egypt_0004.title: Amarna Grenzstele U 04.jpg
egypt_0004.notes: A weathered vertical rock face carved with a large upper panel of eroded rows of script and, below it, badly worn standing human figures in shallow relief flanking the panel.
egypt_0004.notes_sonnet: A weathered rock-cut surface shows a standing human figure carved in low relief in a niche at bottom left, with a vertical panel of small carved script or glyph-like marks above and to the right, all set into an eroded stone wall.

egypt_0005.title: Amarna Grenzstele U 05.jpg
egypt_0005.notes: A tall weathered rock face carved with a large recessed panel of dense horizontal lines of glyph text, with heavily eroded standing figures flanking the panel at the sides and the lower portion broken away.
egypt_0005.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface bears a large upper panel of small carved horizontal lines of script arranged in multiple rows, with a rougher, eroded lower section showing faint traces of additional carved marks.

egypt_0006.title: Amarna Grenzstele U 06.jpg
egypt_0006.notes: A heavily weathered vertical panel cut into a cliff face, with a large upper field of faint eroded inscribed lines and, in a recessed lower niche, one or two badly eroded standing figures carved in relief.
egypt_0006.notes_sonnet: A weathered rock-cut surface shows a large upper panel of faint carved text/glyphs above a lower register containing two small standing human figures carved into niches, all heavily eroded.

egypt_0007.title: Amarna Grenzstele U 07.jpg
egypt_0007.notes: A large weathered rock face carved with a rectangular panel of many horizontal lines of small glyphs, flanked at lower left and right by heavily eroded standing human figures cut into shallow niches.
egypt_0007.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone wall carved with multiple horizontal bands of dense script or glyph blocks, with a standing human figure carved in a niche at the lower left edge of the surface.

egypt_0009.title: Amarna Grenzstele U 09.jpg
egypt_0009.notes: A weathered rock face bearing a large smoothed rectangular panel filled with faint horizontal lines of eroded inscription above, and below it a row of badly worn standing human-shaped figures carved in shallow niches.
egypt_0009.notes_sonnet: A large eroded rock face shows an upper panel of dense carved script-like columns above a lower band with two flanking standing human figures carved in low relief, all heavily weathered.

egypt_0010.title: Amarna boundary stela U 01.JPG
egypt_0010.notes: A weathered stone wall covered in many horizontal lines of small carved glyph signs, including bird-shaped and circular signs, with the lower portion badly eroded and blank.
egypt_0010.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface covered in dense horizontal rows of small carved script or glyph-like marks, with two small human figures visible near the top.

egypt_0012.title: Amarna boundary stela U 03.JPG
egypt_0012.notes: A badly weathered projecting block of pale rock retains faint carved signs in its upper portion, including a ring or disc shape and several angular glyph-like marks, with the lower two-thirds eroded blank.
egypt_0012.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface bears faint carved marks near the top, including a circular shape and several vertical and small glyph-like incisions, set within an otherwise rough, unworked rock face.

egypt_0013.title: Amarna boundary stele A.jpg
egypt_0013.notes: A rounded-top panel with an upper pictorial scene of two tall standing figures and smaller attendants approaching a laden offering stand beneath a rayed disc, all framed and followed by numerous horizontal bands of glyphic text, many of them blank or eroded.
egypt_0013.notes_sonnet: A large arched panel shows two robed human figures facing each other beneath a radiating sun disc with small birds and text along the top, an offering stand between them, smaller attendant figures to the side, and the lower portion filled with dense horizontal bands of text/glyphs.

egypt_0014.title: Amarna boundary stele S.jpg
egypt_0014.notes: A rounded-top slab with a mirror-symmetric upper scene of tall crowned figures with attendants flanking a central rayed disc, above numerous horizontal bands of dense script, several lines of which are worn/hatched.
egypt_0014.notes_sonnet: An arched panel shows a symmetrical scene of standing human figures with raised arms beneath a central sun disc and flanking columns of script, above numerous horizontal registers of dense hieroglyphic text and plain textured bands.

egypt_0015.title: Amarna boundary stele U.jpg
egypt_0015.notes: A rounded-top slab with an upper scene of standing figures with raised arms before a rayed disc and a laden offering stand, flanked by small glyph panels, above a large field of many horizontal lines of dense script, with a crack running through the lower portion.
egypt_0015.notes_sonnet: An arched stele with a top scene of standing human figures facing a radiant disc beside an offering stand piled with goods, above many horizontal rows of dense hieroglyphic text filling the lower two-thirds of the surface.

egypt_0016.title: Amarna stele10.jpg
egypt_0016.notes: A weathered stone wall photographed at an oblique angle, covered edge to edge with many horizontal lines of small carved sign-like shapes, including circles, vertical strokes, and a few small bird-shaped and implement-shaped signs, with a vertical crack running through the upper area.
egypt_0016.notes_sonnet: The surface is densely covered with small horizontal rows of carved sign-like shapes, including some rounded loop or disc-like forms, running diagonally across a worn stone face with a visible crack.

egypt_0017.title: Amarna stele11.jpg
egypt_0017.notes: A weathered stone wall carved in shallow relief with dense horizontal rows of small glyph-like signs, including oval-ringed groups, plus an upper band of repeated rounded motifs and a partly eroded large figure near the top.
egypt_0017.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface densely covered with carved script/glyph blocks arranged in multiple horizontal rows, with a small quadruped figure and a circular element interspersed among the text near the upper portion.

egypt_0018.title: Amarna stele14.jpg
egypt_0018.notes: A weathered rock face carved with many horizontal rows of small glyph signs, including rows of rounded vessel-like and circular signs, with a single larger raised figure standing near the top center.
egypt_0018.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface densely covered with rows of carved glyph-like symbols arranged in multiple horizontal bands, with a single standing human figure visible near the upper portion of the panel.

egypt_0020.title: Amarna stele3.jpg
egypt_0020.notes: A heavily eroded stone wall carved with dense rows of small glyph blocks below a larger upper scene containing a winged motif and a standing figure, with two weathered standing figures at the bottom edge.
egypt_0020.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface shows a carved standing figure at the upper portion holding a staff-like object, with dense columns of small carved script or glyph-like marks filling most of the panel below, flanked by heavily eroded rock and two partially visible worn statue-like forms at the base.

egypt_0021.title: Amarna stele4.jpg
egypt_0021.notes: A weathered rock face at upper left carries many horizontal lines of faint incised glyph-like signs, while the rest of the surface is eroded, cracked, undecorated stone.
egypt_0021.notes_sonnet: A weathered rock surface with a column of faint carved script or glyph-like marks on the upper left portion, set into an eroded, fractured rock face with rubble at the base.

egypt_0024.title: Amarna stele9.jpg
egypt_0024.notes: A large, heavily eroded stone wall carved in shallow relief with many horizontal rows of small glyph signs, including bird-shaped and circular signs, plus one slightly larger figural carving near the upper area.
egypt_0024.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface densely covered with small carved glyph-like blocks arranged in horizontal lines, with a single small human figure near the top edge.

egypt_0027.title: Archaeological survey of Egypt memoir (1893) (14597144058).jpg
egypt_0027.notes: A heavily eroded carved rock panel showing an upper scene with a rayed disc above two flanking standing figures, over a large field of small rectangular glyph-like signs.
egypt_0027.notes_sonnet: A weathered rock face shows a radiating disc or sunburst motif at the top and a dense field of small carved script-like marks below it, with a vertical rod or pole leaning against the surface in the foreground.

egypt_0028.title: Archaeological survey of Egypt memoir (1893) (14597268377).jpg
egypt_0028.notes: Line drawing of an arched panel: at left several vertical columns of small glyph signs (including bird and snake shapes), at right a large rayed disc whose rays end in small hands descends over standing human figures with raised arms before a heavily laden offering table.
egypt_0028.notes_sonnet: A raised disc emits many rays that terminate in small hands, shining down on a raised altar or offering table stacked with rounded loaves, while a tall human figure raises an arm toward it and other smaller human figures stand behind, with the whole scene bordered by columns of glyph blocks; the left panel shows separate vertical columns of script.

egypt_0032.title: Archaeological survey of Egypt memoir (1893) (14783445982).jpg
egypt_0032.notes: An arched carved slab with an upper pictorial panel of standing human figures in two mirrored groups with raised arms beneath a rayed disc, above a large field of dense glyph rows, the lower portion badly damaged and cracked.
egypt_0032.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab with a top register showing a symmetrical arrangement of standing human figures flanking a central radiating disc, above many rows of dense script filling the lower two-thirds of the surface, with cracks and losses across the stone.

egypt_0033.title: Archaeological survey of Egypt memoir (1893) (14783447082).jpg
egypt_0033.notes: A large arched panel carved into a weathered rock face, with an upper scene of standing figures flanking a central rayed disc above small table-like objects, and a large lower field filled with many horizontal lines of glyph signs, much of it damaged.
egypt_0033.notes_sonnet: A large carved stone slab set into a rock-cut niche shows a row of standing human figures beneath a radiating disc at the top, above dense columns of small script covering the lower two-thirds of the surface.

egypt_0035.title: Archaeological survey of Egypt memoir (1893) (14803642853).jpg
egypt_0035.notes: A large weathered stone face covered edge to edge with dense columns of small incised wedge-like signs, heavily pitted and eroded, with a measuring scale at the bottom of the photograph.
egypt_0035.notes_sonnet: A worn stone surface covered edge to edge with vertical columns of small carved script or glyph-like marks, with no discernible figural imagery due to erosion.

egypt_0037.title: Egyptian Cartouche from Stela (48464945702).jpg
egypt_0037.notes: A broken rectangular stone slab carved in low relief with a central vertical oval frame enclosing small glyph signs including a standing bird in profile and two round discs, flanked on both sides by vertical strips of repeated chevron and short-bar patterns.
egypt_0037.notes_sonnet: A carved stone fragment shows a central vertical cartouche-like oval containing a small bird figure and a circular sign, flanked on both sides by vertical columns of glyph-like marks and bands of repeated chevron (zigzag) patterning.

egypt_0038.title: Egyptian Hieroglyphic Text (48464951027).jpg
egypt_0038.notes: A rectangular stone slab carved in shallow relief with many ruled horizontal lines of small glyph signs (including bird, circle and vessel shapes) above a lower field where two seated/kneeling human figures face inward across columns of glyphs.
egypt_0038.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab covered in dense rows of small glyph-like signs arranged in horizontal and vertical columns, with two seated human figures facing each other near the bottom corners.

egypt_0039.title: Egyptian Stela (48464716126).jpg
egypt_0039.notes: A round-topped stone slab carved in low relief with two horizontal registers of human figures in profile, some seated on chairs facing standing figures across a table piled with vessels and offerings, with columns of small glyph-like signs at the upper left.
egypt_0039.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab with two registers showing seated and standing human figures around tables laden with stacked vessels, accompanied by columns of incised script.

egypt_0040.title: Egyptian Stela (48464726186).jpg
egypt_0040.notes: A round-topped stone slab carved in shallow sunk relief with three horizontal registers of seated and standing human figures facing offering tables, surrounded by dense columns of small pictorial glyphs.
