egypt_0040.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab with an arched top divided into three horizontal registers, each containing seated human figures on the sides and dense columns of small glyph-like script filling most of the surface.

egypt_0041.title: Egyptian Stela (48464795481).jpg
egypt_0041.notes: A round-topped carved slab in low relief showing a large seated figure with a tall elaborate headdress holding sceptre-like implements, faced by a smaller standing figure with a raised arm behind a stand bearing vessels and plant-like offerings, with small glyph blocks filling the upper right area.
egypt_0041.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab, pointed at the top, showing a seated figure on a chair being approached by two standing figures, with rows of small script/glyph blocks and a plant-like motif above, all rendered in low relief.

egypt_0042.title: Egyptian Stela (48464822826).jpg
egypt_0042.notes: A rounded-topped stone slab carved in low relief with a symmetrical winged disc and paired rearing serpents plus a glyph line in the lunette, a middle band of standing figures (some with animal heads and staffs, one crowned with a disc) facing kneeling figures with raised arms across a small offering stand, and a lower field filled with many horizontal lines of glyphs.
egypt_0042.notes_sonnet: A rounded stone slab shows a top band with a spread-winged bird motif flanking a central disc above two upright cobra-like forms, a middle register with a row of standing human figures in profile some holding staffs and one before a small plant form, and multiple lower bands filled with rows of script-like glyphs.

egypt_0043.title: Egyptian Stela (48464876702).jpg
egypt_0043.notes: A rounded-top stone slab in shallow relief showing two seated human figures turned toward each other across a low table piled with round and vessel-like offerings, with small glyph signs above and two ruled horizontal lines of script across the lower portion.
egypt_0043.notes_sonnet: A worn stone stela shows a seated figure on the left facing a standing figure on the right, with small round objects on a stand between them, hieroglyphic text above and in horizontal bands below.

egypt_0044.title: Egyptian Stela (48464879127).jpg
egypt_0044.notes: An arched, cracked stone slab carved in low relief shows a large standing figure at left facing a smaller seated/standing figure at right across a heaped offering table with round and jar-shaped items beneath a patterned canopy, with a column of glyph-like signs at upper left and a lower band containing small elongated objects and a tiny figure.
egypt_0044.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone relief fragment showing a large standing human figure on the left facing a cluster of smaller seated or crouching figures, with another standing figure to the right and small glyph-like marks and a geometric band near the top.

egypt_0045.title: Egyptian Stela (48464886097).jpg
egypt_0045.notes: A rounded-topped stone slab carved in shallow relief with a symmetrical pair of eye motifs and a symbol in the arched lunette, two ruled lines of glyph script beneath, and three horizontal registers of seated and kneeling human figures facing one another across small offering stands and vessels, with short glyph columns between them.
egypt_0045.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab divided into several horizontal registers, with rows of incised text/glyph blocks alternating with rows of small seated and standing human figures facing each other, and a small container-like object in the lowest register.

egypt_0046.title: Egyptian Stela (48464955997).jpg
egypt_0046.notes: A rounded-top stone slab carved in shallow sunk relief with a band of glyph blocks across the upper area and, below, a row of four standing long-robed figures in profile with raised arms, the leftmost crowned by a plain disc and one holding a slender staff-like object; one head is stylised enough that an animal-headed reading is possible.
egypt_0046.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows three standing human figures in long garments with one raising an arm toward a small disc, above a horizontal band of script or glyph blocks.

egypt_0047.title: Egyptian Stela (48464958252).jpg
egypt_0047.notes: A rounded-top slab carved in low relief with two stacked scenes of standing robed figures facing one another across offering stands, with glyph-like signs filling the upper field and small plant-like and vessel forms below.
egypt_0047.notes_sonnet: A worn, pointed stone slab carved in low relief showing two registers of standing human figures with raised or gesturing arms, separated by columns of script-like glyph blocks, with a plant-like motif and a slender staff-shaped object in the lower left corner.

egypt_0048.title: Egyptian Stela (48464983422).jpg
egypt_0048.notes: A round-topped stone slab carved in low relief: an upper arc holds a winged disc flanked by two rearing serpent forms, and below it a standing human figure with a long staff faces a similarly sized figure with an animal/bird head crowned by a disc, with columns of small glyph signs and oval cartouche-like frames between them; the lower third is plain.
egypt_0048.notes_sonnet: A stone slab with an arched top shows a winged sun-disc and hieroglyphic text in the upper register, and below it two standing figures—one human, one falcon-headed—facing each other across a small stand, each holding a staff.

egypt_0049.title: Egyptian Stela (48464986242).jpg
egypt_0049.notes: A round-topped slab carved in shallow relief with an arched hatched band and central disc at the apex, a single row of small standing/seated human figures with staffs and offering objects beneath it, and the remaining two-thirds filled with many horizontal lines of small glyph signs (including bird and snake signs) plus a bottom band of short vertical glyph columns.
egypt_0049.notes_sonnet: An arched stone slab with a row of small seated human figures and a disc at the top, followed by many horizontal lines of dense script filling the remainder of the surface.

egypt_0050.title: Egyptian Stela Dedicated by Priest Neferrenpet to God Ptah, Deir-el-Medina, Dynasty 20, 1196-1070 BC (48464807786).jpg
egypt_0050.notes: A rounded-top stone slab in low relief with an upper scene of a standing tightly-wrapped figure holding a tall object facing a seated figure with raised hands across an offering stand bearing a vessel, above four horizontal lines of carved glyphs.
egypt_0050.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows two standing human figures facing each other at the top, one holding a staff-like object, above several horizontal bands of small carved script or glyph symbols filling the lower two-thirds of the surface.

egypt_0051.title: In Amarna 3.jpg
egypt_0051.notes: A cliff face bears a large rectangular carved panel of dense horizontal lines of script in the upper zone, with a recessed niche below containing several heavily eroded standing upright figures in relief.
egypt_0051.notes_sonnet: A large weathered rock face carved with a broad panel of dense rows of small script or glyphs above, and two eroded standing human-like figures carved into a niche at the lower left of the panel.

egypt_0053.title: Queen Nefert-iti and Princess Meket-Aten on boundary stela, Tell el-Amarna, 18th Dynasty, 1353-1336 BCE - Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art - DSC08150.JPG
egypt_0053.notes: A broken pale stone slab carved in shallow relief with a large profile human head and shoulders at center, a rounded disc-like element above, and a smaller standing figure with an outstretched arm at the right edge.
egypt_0053.notes_sonnet: Weathered stone relief fragment showing a profile human head and shoulder beside a large plain disc, with a rectangular recess and faint vertical striations to the right, all set against an irregularly shaped worn stone surface.

egypt_0056.title: The rock tombs of El Amarna (1903) (14589800637).jpg
egypt_0056.notes: An arched panel in which a large rayed disc at the apex sends straight lines ending in small hands down over two large facing human figures flanked by smaller attendants holding handled objects, with dense glyph columns between them and several long horizontal glyph bands filling the lower third.

egypt_0059.title: The rock tombs of El Amarna (1903) (14773151751).jpg
egypt_0059.notes: A large arched panel carved into a rock face, with an upper scene of standing human figures flanking a central axis beneath a rayed disc, above many horizontal lines of dense glyph-like script filling the lower two-thirds.
egypt_0059.notes_sonnet: A large carved rock-cut panel with an arched top framing a row of small standing human figures beneath a radiating disc, above dense horizontal bands of small script covering most of the surface, with a single larger standing figure visible lower on the panel.

egypt_0060.title: TunaGebelBoundaryStela.jpg
egypt_0060.notes: A round-topped stone slab whose upper third carries a carved scene of a tall standing figure with headgear before a laden table beneath a rayed disc, with smaller figures and an upright staff-like object at the right, framed and followed below by many closely ruled lines of incised script.
egypt_0060.notes_sonnet: An eroded carved wall panel shows a top register with a radiating disc and columns of glyph text flanking a scene of standing human figures, one raising an arm toward the disc and another holding an object, above a large plain lower area with faint horizontal glyph lines, all under strong raking light and shadow.

egypt_0061.title: TunaGebelBoundaryStelaDetail.jpg
egypt_0061.notes: A badly eroded standing human figure carved in the round against a back slab on a stepped stone base, missing its head and arms, with faint columns of incised glyph-like signs on the walls and slab behind it.
egypt_0061.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone relief shows a headless nude human torso carved on a projecting pilaster, with faint columns of small glyph-like marks incised beside it on the surrounding wall surface.

egypt_0062.title: TunaGebelBoundaryStelaTop.jpg
egypt_0062.notes: A shallow carved wall scene under a curved top edge shows a large rayed disc emitting downward beams over two tall standing figures with raised arms, a laden offering stand with vessels, two small figures at the right, and dense columns of glyph blocks framing the scene with a horizontal glyph band along the bottom.
egypt_0062.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone relief panel shows a central sun-disc radiating light above two bird-headed human figures flanking a stand with vessels, with vertical columns of glyph text and small human figures below, all bordered by bands of small hieroglyphic or geometric text.

egypt_0063.title: Vatican Museums (25).jpg
egypt_0063.notes: A round-topped stone slab in shallow relief with a winged disc motif in the lunette, two horizontal lines of glyphs beneath, and three stacked registers of seated and standing human figures flanking small offering tables with vessels, interspersed with glyph columns.
egypt_0063.notes_sonnet: A worn stone slab with a rounded top, divided into several horizontal registers each containing rows of small seated and standing human figures alongside blocks of script, with some figures holding small container-like objects.

egypt_0064.title: Vatican Museums (26).jpg
egypt_0064.notes: A round-topped stone slab carved in shallow sunk relief with dense columns of small glyph signs (including bird and plant forms) and three horizontal registers containing seated human figures, some facing one another across offering tables and vessels.
egypt_0064.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab with an arched top divided into three horizontal registers containing seated human figures on the sides, dense vertical columns of script filling most of the surface, and a bird figure and small round object visible in the central register.

egypt_0065.title: Vatican Museums (27).jpg
egypt_0065.notes: A round-topped carved slab, broken at the right edge, showing a standing figure at left with arm extended toward a heap of vessels and plant-like offerings on a stand, a smaller seated or standing figure at right holding a long staff beneath a hatched canopy, small glyph-like blocks at upper left, and a lower band containing elongated objects.
egypt_0065.notes_sonnet: A weathered carved stone fragment shows a row of standing human figures in profile flanking a central cluster of rounded, stacked objects resembling containers or offerings, with a staff-like element and a disc shape near the top.

egypt_0066.title: Vatican Museums (28).jpg
egypt_0066.notes: An arched stone slab carved in low relief showing a seated figure at left facing a standing figure at right across a low table stacked with rounded vessels and offerings, with small glyph signs in the upper curved field and two horizontal lines of glyphs across the lower portion.
egypt_0066.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a seated figure on the left facing a standing figure on the right, with small round and container-like objects between them, above a band of incised script at the bottom.

egypt_0067.title: Vatican Museums (29).jpg
egypt_0067.notes: A rounded-top stone slab carved in shallow relief with an upper scene of seated and standing human figures flanking a laden offering table beneath rows of glyph signs, and a lower band of smaller seated and kneeling figures with vessels.
egypt_0067.notes_sonnet: A worn, rounded-top stone slab incised with two horizontal registers showing seated and standing human figures with a tall stack of round loaves or offerings between them, accompanied by vertical columns of script; the lower register shows additional seated figures at a table.

egypt_0068.title: Vatican Museums (44).jpg
egypt_0068.notes: A round-topped carved slab with a winged disc flanked by rearing serpent-like signs in the arched upper field, and below a scene of a standing human figure with a tall headdress holding a long staff facing an animal-headed figure crowned with a disc, with columns of small glyph blocks and a small stand between them.
egypt_0068.notes_sonnet: Arched stone slab carved in low relief with a curved sky-like band at top, a row of text/glyph blocks below, and a central register showing two standing figures facing each other across a small stand, one with a bird-form head and a raised staff, the other human with raised arm, flanked by a disc and a curved object; a plain undecorated band lies at the bottom.

egypt_0069.title: Vatican Museums (45).jpg
egypt_0069.notes: A round-topped slab carved in shallow relief with a large winged disc in the arched lunette, a band of small seated and standing figures holding staffs beneath it, and roughly a dozen ruled horizontal lines of dense pictorial glyphs (including many bird, animal, plant and vessel signs) filling the lower two-thirds.
egypt_0069.notes_sonnet: A stone slab with a rounded top showing a winged sun-disc and a row of seated human figures at the top, above many horizontal lines of dense script filling the rest of the surface.

egypt_0070.title: Vatican Museums (46).jpg
egypt_0070.notes: A rounded-top slab with a large winged disc flanked by rearing serpent forms in the lunette, a middle band of standing animal-headed figures holding staffs faced by smaller kneeling human figures with raised arms, and a lower block of several lines of carved glyphs.
egypt_0070.notes_sonnet: An arched stone slab with a wide-winged bird motif and central disc at the top above a row of upright serpents, a middle register of several standing human figures including one with a bird head interacting with a smaller crouching figure, and several lower registers filled with dense rows of small carved script-like glyphs.

egypt_0071.title: Vatican Museums-1 (05).jpg
egypt_0071.notes: An upright slab in sunk relief shows a standing figure holding a long staff facing a second figure with arms raised in greeting, with an offering stand and vessel between them, glyph blocks filling the upper right corner and four horizontal lines of glyphs across the lower half.
egypt_0071.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows two standing human figures facing one another beside a tall staff-like object, with blocks of script above them and several additional horizontal rows of glyphs filling the lower portion of the stone.

egypt_0072.title: Vatican Museums-1 (08).jpg
egypt_0072.notes: A round-topped stone slab carved in shallow relief with two stacked scenes of standing and seated long-robed human figures flanking tables laden with vessels and tall conical offerings, with rows of small glyph signs filling the upper area and gaps.
egypt_0072.notes_sonnet: A worn stone slab carved in two registers, each showing standing robed human figures facing one another around small stands or vessels, with rows of small glyph-like marks and vertical staff-like objects filling the surrounding space.

egypt_0073.title: Vatican Museums-1 (09).jpg
egypt_0073.notes: A rounded-top stone slab carved in low relief with two large seated figures at left facing right, a smaller standing figure at right presenting offerings over a laden table, a winged disc with flanking serpent forms in the arched upper area, and small glyph blocks in the upper right.
egypt_0073.notes_sonnet: A carved stone stela shows a seated figure with an elaborate headdress facing a standing figure who offers a container of food, with columns of script filling the upper field, all rendered in shallow raised relief on a pointed-top slab.

egypt_0074.title: Vatican Museums-1 (10).jpg
egypt_0074.notes: A rounded-top stone slab carved in shallow relief with a row of four standing human figures in profile, some with raised arms and one wearing a tall headdress, a small circle at upper left, and blocks of glyph-like signs across the top.
egypt_0074.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a row of three or four standing human figures in profile, one wearing a rounded headdress and another holding a staff-like object and a small vessel, with a band of script or glyph blocks above them.

egypt_0075.title: Vatican Museums-1 (11).jpg
egypt_0075.notes: A roughly square stone slab carved in shallow relief with many horizontal lines of small pictorial glyphs filling the upper two-thirds, and a lower panel where two kneeling human figures at the left and right edges face inward toward vertical columns of glyphs between them.
egypt_0075.notes_sonnet: A rectangular stone slab covered mostly in dense horizontal lines of carved script, with two small kneeling human figures facing each other in a separate lower register.

egypt_0076.title: Xx dinastia, stele dedicata a ptah da neferrenpet, da dei el medina, 1196-1070 ac ca.JPG
egypt_0076.notes: A rectangular slab in low relief shows a rigid standing figure at left holding a long staff and an object, facing a kneeling figure at right with raised hands, with a vessel on a stand between them and blocks of small glyph signs above and in four lines below.
egypt_0076.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows two standing human figures facing each other in the upper register, one holding a staff-like object over an offering stand, above several horizontal bands of small script/glyph columns filling the lower two-thirds of the surface.

egypt_0077.title: אסטלת הגבול A בטונה אל ג'אבל.jpg
egypt_0077.notes: Upper scene shows a large radiating disc above standing figures with raised arms beside a table of offerings, over a large lower field densely filled with rows of carved glyph signs.
egypt_0077.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface shows a scene with several standing human figures and an offering table beneath a radiating disc at the top, with dense blocks of script filling the upper register and covering most of the lower two-thirds of the surface.

maya_0000.title: Aguateca-plaza.jpg
maya_0000.notes: A tall upright slab carved in low relief with a single standing frontal/profile human figure in elaborate attire occupying most of the surface, accompanied by a vertical column of squarish glyph-like blocks along the left edge.
maya_0000.notes_sonnet: A weathered upright stone slab carved with a single standing human figure in profile-facing pose and a small rectangular glyph block above, set before a stepped stone platform surrounded by dense forest.

maya_0005.title: Balakbal Stela 5, left side.jpg
maya_0005.notes: A tall weathered stone slab carved in low relief with numerous rectangular, rounded-cornered glyph blocks arranged in stacked rows and paired columns, many containing dense curvilinear internal motifs.
maya_0005.notes_sonnet: A tall narrow stone surface divided into many stacked horizontal registers filled with carved rounded glyph-like blocks and circular motifs arranged in two vertical columns.

maya_0009.title: Balakbal, Campeche, Stela 5 inscription.jpg
maya_0009.notes: A tall narrow surface bearing two vertical columns of about twelve rows of rectangular sign blocks, many containing small faces, dotted rows of circles and hatched or banded infill, with parts of the field left blank or eroded.
maya_0009.notes_sonnet: A vertical panel organized into two columns (A and B) of stacked glyph-like blocks arranged in twelve horizontal registers, most blocks composed of abstract curvilinear and geometric motifs with occasional circular elements and one small staff-like or elongated object near the bottom.

maya_0011.title: British Museum Mesoamerica 002.jpg
maya_0011.notes: A rectangular stone slab carved in low relief with a grid of roughly eight rows by four columns of dense rounded glyph blocks, many containing face-like profiles within them.
maya_0011.notes_sonnet: A stone slab carved with multiple horizontal rows of rectangular blocks containing abstract script-like signs and rounded glyph forms, arranged in a grid across several registers.

maya_0019.title: Carved Column (Warrior with Two Dwarf Attendants), Mexico, State of Campeche, Maya, Late Classic, circa 850 AD, limestone, Pre-Columbian collection, Worcester Art Museum - IMG 7642.JPG
maya_0019.artist: Artisans unknown; I took this photograph.
maya_0019.notes: A tall cylindrical stone block carved in deep relief with a single frontal standing figure wearing a towering plumed headdress with a rosette disc and mask-like faces, an ornate patterned apron with small glyph-like blocks, and smaller subsidiary faces at the lower edges.
maya_0019.notes_sonnet: A tall, roughly cylindrical carved stone shaft shows a single large frontal human figure with an elaborate feathered/geometric headdress, a circular disc emblem above the head, flanking vertical bands of repeated abstract pattern, and vertical columns of glyph-like blocks running down the body, with a staff-like element held at the figure's side.

maya_0023.title: Cheyokolnah, Campeche, Stela 1.jpg
maya_0023.notes: A large fallen, moss-covered stone block lying in forest, with a weathered horizontal row of squarish carved relief blocks resembling glyph cartouches along its exposed face.
maya_0023.notes_sonnet: An elongated stone surface bears a horizontal band of carved rectangular blocks with abstract linear motifs, resembling a sequence of glyph-like panels, set against surrounding forest ground litter and vegetation.

maya_0024.title: Chuctiepa Altar.png
maya_0024.artist: Franz Blom, and Oliver La Farge
maya_0024.notes: A rectangular surface framed on all four sides by a continuous band of squarish glyph blocks, enclosing a plain hatched central disc flanked by four small glyph-like signs in the upper and lower corners, with a crack running diagonally across.
maya_0024.notes_sonnet: A rectangular border of carved glyph-like blocks frames an inner field containing a large plain hatched circle at center and smaller irregular blobs scattered near the corners of the interior.

maya_0026.title: Clevelandart 1962.32.jpg
maya_0026.notes: A carved stone slab shows a large standing figure in profile wearing an elaborate plumed headdress with an animal/beaked head and a patterned garment, holding a small effigy-like object, flanked by columns of glyph blocks on both sides.
maya_0026.notes_sonnet: A single richly attired standing figure wearing an elaborate bird-form headdress and feathered cape dominates the center, flanked on both sides by vertical columns of carved glyph blocks.

maya_0027.title: De young museum, stele della regina Ix Mutal Ahaw, 761.JPG
maya_0027.notes: A tall carved stone slab in low relief showing a single standing frontal figure in an elaborate towering headdress with beaded ornaments, flanked by curving serpentine scroll forms, holding a horizontal bar-like object, above a band of rectangular glyph-like blocks at the base.
maya_0027.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a large central human figure wearing an elaborate feathered headdress with a bird motif above, flanked by scrollwork and serpent-like curling elements, with small glyph blocks in the upper corners and a plain band at the base.

maya_0028.title: Dibujo reconstructivo de la estela 5 de Izapa.png
maya_0028.notes: A carved relief panel showing a large central tree-like form flanked symmetrically by several seated and standing elaborately costumed human figures holding objects, framed by bands of repeated abstract pattern along the top, bottom and edges.
maya_0028.notes_sonnet: A carved panel shows a central tree-like form flanked by two facing human figures, with additional seated and standing figures below, a band of glyph-like blocks and geometric patterning across the top, and a wavy line pattern along the bottom edge.

maya_0039.title: Flickr - archer10 (Dennis) - Guatemala-1280.jpg
maya_0039.notes: Heavily eroded carved stone surface in low relief showing an ornate standing figure with elaborate headdress on the right and a column of square glyph blocks along the left edge, with scrolled and lattice-like ornament above.
maya_0039.notes_sonnet: A worn stone surface shows a large carved figure with elaborate headdress-like detailing at top, a circular element to the left, and a block of glyphic text in the lower left corner, all rendered in low relief with significant surface erosion.

maya_0045.title: Gran Museo del Mundo Maya - Dic 2018 37.jpg
maya_0045.notes: Heavily eroded carved stone slab with a banded upper zone including a large spiral, a middle row of squarish glyph-like blocks with round elements, and a lower zone with two seated or kneeling figures facing each other flanking a vertical element.
maya_0045.notes_sonnet: A worn stone relief shows three roughly similar humanoid figures arranged side by side in a lower zone, beneath an upper zone containing a spiral motif and rectangular block shapes resembling glyphs or abstract patterning.

maya_0047.title: Gran Museo del Mundo Maya - Dic 2018 39.jpg
maya_0047.notes: A tall weathered stone slab carved in shallow relief with an intricate curvilinear design filling the whole face, including a large upright figure-like form, a short band of repeated hatch marks at mid-right, and eye-and-snout-like motifs along the lower edge.
maya_0047.notes_sonnet: A heavily eroded stone slab bears low-relief carving organized in several horizontal zones, with blocky glyph-like forms near the top, repeated vertical linear and lattice-like patterns in the middle, and small ring-like shapes near the bottom, but surface wear makes precise identification of any figures uncertain.

maya_0048.title: Guatemala, maya, pannello con donna reale, 795 dc ca.jpg
maya_0048.notes: A carved stone panel showing one large standing figure in an elaborate plumed headdress and patterned garment, with a smaller figure emerging from a serpent-like head at its side, flanked by columns of glyph blocks.
maya_0048.notes_sonnet: A large central figure wears an elaborate bird-form headdress with wings and beak-like elements, with a smaller human figure beside it and dense blocks of glyphic text framing both sides and top.

maya_0050.title: Honduran mayan tablet.jpg
maya_0050.notes: A rectangular stone slab carved in low relief with a grid of rounded glyph blocks arranged in roughly six rows and four columns, several containing face-like motifs.
maya_0050.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone slab divided into a grid of multiple horizontal rows and vertical columns, each cell containing carved abstract glyph-like shapes and circular motifs.

maya_0051.title: Incidents of travel in Central America, Chiapas, and Yucatán (1853) (14591550330).jpg
maya_0051.notes: A tall upright carved slab bearing a large frontal standing human figure in an elaborate tall headdress and heavy ornaments, surrounded by dense scrollwork, small subsidiary faces and masks, set on a low plinth before foliage.
maya_0051.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone slab shows a large central standing human figure in an elaborate headdress with a smaller human figure below, surrounded by dense abstract scrollwork, circular ornaments, a bird-like creature and animal heads near the top, and a staff-like object at the base, all rendered in deep, worn relief.

maya_0052.title: Incidents of travel in Central America, Chiapas, and Yucatán (1853) (14591563018).jpg
maya_0052.notes: A tall block-like carved monolith bearing a single frontal standing figure with a broad calm face, towering ornate headdress, heavy ear ornaments, beaded collar and belt with small subsidiary faces and figures, surrounded by dense scroll and glyph-like carving, set on a plinth amid rubble.
maya_0052.notes_sonnet: A tall, densely carved vertical stone slab depicting a large central human-like face surrounded by an elaborate headdress packed with smaller figures, scrollwork, and bird-like forms, with a standing human body with hands holding round objects below, all rendered with symmetrical, layered ornamentation.

maya_0053.title: Incidents of travel in Central America, Chiapas, and Yucatán (1853) (14591581979).jpg
maya_0053.artist:
Stephens, John Lloyd, 1805-1852;

Harper & Brothers, publisher
maya_0053.notes: A tall carved pillar whose front bears a vertical column of five framed blocks filled with small dense face-and-sign motifs, edged by repeating scroll-and-boss ornament, with a seated hatted onlooker drawn beside its base for scale.
maya_0053.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone pillar divided into five stacked panels, each framed by dense interlaced geometric border patterns and containing symmetrical glyph-like or mask-like carved symbols, with a grotesque face-like motif at the base; a modern seated figure beside it is shown only for scale and is not part of the carved composition.

maya_0054.title: Incidents of travel in Central America, Chiapas, and Yucatán (1853) (14591606699).jpg
maya_0054.notes: A tall four-sided carved pillar standing on stone blocks, with one visible face filled by stacked rows of rectangular glyph-like blocks and the adjacent face bearing a standing human figure in elaborate headdress and ornaments, accompanied by smaller heads and faces above and below.
maya_0054.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone slab with a vertical column of glyph blocks on the left side and a densely layered arrangement of human figures with elaborate headdresses stacked along the right edge, all rendered in deep relief against a sketched forest backdrop.

maya_0056.title: Incidents of travel in Central America, Chiapas, and Yucatán (1853) (14775897294).jpg
maya_0056.artist:
Stephens, John Lloyd, 1805-1852;

Harper & Brothers, publisher
maya_0056.notes: A tall upright carved slab shows a frontal standing figure with elaborate headdress, collar, belt with hanging panels and beaded ornaments, surmounted by a dense zone of scroll-like creature masks and glyph-like blocks, set among trees and fallen stones.
maya_0056.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone slab shows a central human-like face with elaborate headdress and crossed arms at chest, flanked by ornate symmetrical panels, with a bird-like element at the top and possible reptilian or animal motifs near the base, all rendered in dense low-relief carving.

maya_0057.title: Incidents of travel in Central America, Chiapas, and Yucatán (1853) (14777924832).jpg
maya_0057.artist:
Stephens, John Lloyd, 1805-1852;

Harper & Brothers, publisher
maya_0057.notes: A tall rectangular carved slab on a low base is covered in two vertical columns of densely packed square relief glyph blocks arranged in many stacked rows, with a seated hatted man holding a long pole at its base for scale.
maya_0057.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone slab densely covered with rows of glyph-like blocks arranged in two vertical columns across many horizontal registers, standing upright in a forest clearing with a seated human figure in modern clothing and a hat resting beside it holding a staff for scale.

maya_0060.title: Incidents of travel in Central America, Chiapas, and Yucatán (1853) (14798111263).jpg
maya_0060.artist:
Stephens, John Lloyd, 1805-1852;

Harper & Brothers, publisher
maya_0060.notes: A tall block carved in high relief with a single frontal standing figure wearing an elaborate headdress, ear ornaments, beaded collar and apron, flanked by dense scroll and mask-like ornament, set in a wooded landscape.
maya_0060.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone slab shows a single standing figure in elaborate costume and headdress with a face mask, holding an object in front of the torso, densely covered with layered decorative motifs and set against a background sketched with trees.

maya_0066.title: Izapa stela 11 (Estela 11 de Izapa).jpg
maya_0066.artist: Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia, México
maya_0066.notes: A weathered upright stone slab carved in low relief with a single frontal standing figure in elaborate headdress and costume, flanked by blocky sign-like panels at the top and dense scroll and step patterning across the lower portion.
maya_0066.notes_sonnet: An eroded upright stone slab shows a tall central figure with an elaborate headdress or feathered element holding a vertical staff, above a band of small glyph-like blocks and a lower register with two paired bird-like scroll motifs.

maya_0069.title: Izapa stela 6 (Estela 6 de Izapa).jpg
maya_0069.artist: Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia, México
maya_0069.notes: A partly buried upright stone slab carved in low relief, with an eroded upper figure with limbs and a large curvilinear zoomorphic head or mask filling the lower half, flanked by scroll-like curl motifs at the right edge.
maya_0069.notes_sonnet: A single carved stone shows a stylized, roughly bilaterally symmetric mask-like face with scroll motifs at the upper corners, above a rounded lower element with a curling band, suggesting one large composite figure carved in low relief.

maya_0070.title: K'iaqbal 07.JPG
maya_0070.notes: A large weathered boulder in grass bears horizontal rows of shallow rectangular carved blocks, resembling banded rows of squared glyph-like cartouches, with the lower left portion eroded away.
maya_0070.notes_sonnet: A weathered elongated stone surface bears rows of small carved rectangular blocks and incised marks resembling glyph-like text arranged in horizontal bands, with the lower portion of the stone broken or eroded away.

maya_0076.title: K'iaqbal 16.JPG
maya_0076.notes: A heavily eroded stone block carved in low relief with rows of rectangular, cartouche-like compartments containing rounded and hooked internal motifs, with grass and dry leaves around the lower edge.
maya_0076.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface divided into horizontal bands, with a top band of small carved rectangular blocks resembling a glyph or brick pattern, and a large worn letter-like or symbol-like shape carved into the lower, smoother portion of the stone.

maya_0077.title: Language Glyphs, Palenque, Late Classic, 600-900 AD.jpg
maya_0077.notes: A tall narrow pale stone slab, mounted upright, carved in low relief with two vertical columns of rounded rectangular glyph blocks stacked in many horizontal rows, with damage along the lower edge.
maya_0077.notes_sonnet: A tall narrow stone slab carved with multiple horizontal rows of rounded rectangular blocks containing abstract script-like signs, some incorporating small circular elements, arranged in a continuous vertical column of registers.

maya_0081.title: Los Alacranes Stela 1.jpg
maya_0081.notes: A weathered carved stone slab, partly buried, showing a column of square glyph-like blocks at the upper left and an eroded seated or standing figure in relief below.
maya_0081.notes_sonnet: A weathered carved stone surface shows a band of glyph-like blocks at the top, a seated or crouching human-like figure in the middle, and a creature with an animal-like head and elongated body at the bottom.

maya_0082.title: Los Alacranes Stela 2 (Estela 2 de Los Alacranes).jpg
maya_0082.notes: A tall weathered upright stone slab bears a low-relief standing frontal figure with elaborate headdress and held staff-like object, flanked by vertical columns of eroded blocky motifs and a patterned band along the base.
maya_0082.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone slab shows a standing human figure in elaborate costume with a vertical staff or ornament, and a small block of glyph-like carving near the base.

maya_0083.title: Maya Stele (9756937593).jpg
maya_0083.notes: A tall worn stone slab carved in low relief with a banded row of rectangular glyph-like blocks across the top and, below, two large elaborately costumed standing figures with scrolled headdresses confronting each other above smaller figures and elongated feather- or plume-like forms at the lower left.

maya_0085.title: Maya Stele Replica (9758716512).jpg
maya_0085.notes: A tall stone slab carved in low relief with a framed rectangular panel filled with rows of rounded, densely detailed glyph-like blocks containing faces, circles and hatched fields.
maya_0085.notes_sonnet: A weathered upright stone slab is carved with a grid of rectangular blocks arranged in multiple horizontal rows, each containing abstract curvilinear and circular motifs resembling script or glyph blocks rather than figural imagery.

maya_0087.title: Maya Stone Stele (9759086594).jpg
maya_0087.notes: A tall, heavily eroded carved stone slab shows a single frontal standing figure in an elaborate headdress and skirt-like garment, flanked by vertical columns of small square carved blocks, with a patterned band across the base.
maya_0087.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a single frontal standing figure in elaborate costume with a headdress, ornamented chest panel with a central disc motif, decorative bands on the limbs, small glyph-like blocks near the top corners, and a geometric step pattern band running along the bottom edge.

maya_0088.title: Maya Stone Stele (9759175423).jpg
maya_0088.notes: A tall stone slab carved in low, heavily eroded relief with a single standing frontal figure wearing an elaborate tall headdress and holding something across the body, flanked at the left by a vertical column of square glyph-like blocks, while the lower half of the slab is plain or worn smooth.
maya_0088.notes_sonnet: A worn stone slab shows a single large frontal human figure with an elaborate headdress and body ornamentation, carved in low relief, with an object resembling a staff or tool near the upper portion and a vertical band of small abstract motifs along the left edge.

maya_0091.title: Maya stelae Aguateca Santiago.JPG
maya_0091.notes: A tall carved stone slab, lit from one side, showing one large standing human figure in elaborate costume and headdress holding a long vertical staff-like object, flanked by columns of rectangular glyph-like blocks, with smaller worn figures and a narrow inscribed band along the base.
maya_0091.notes_sonnet: A single profile human figure with an elaborate headdress raises a staff topped with a fringed, umbrella-like canopy, while a fringed bag or basket hangs at the hip, flanked by vertical columns of rectangular glyph-like blocks and a small rounded object near the base.

maya_0092.title: Maya stele Campeche.jpg
maya_0092.notes: A tall carved slab shows a single standing figure in profile head with elaborate headdress, beaded ornaments and an ornate belt, holding a long bar-like object across the body, with small glyph-like blocks framing the border and masklike faces in the lower area.
maya_0092.notes_sonnet: A single large human figure in elaborate headdress and costume stands frontally holding a staff-like object, surrounded by columns of glyph blocks carved into a stone slab.

maya_0094.title: Mayan stela from Mexico2005.jpg
maya_0094.notes: A cylindrical stone shaft carved in deep relief with a single frontal standing figure wearing an enormous fanged mask-headdress, circular ornaments, a horizontal chest bar and a fringed apron, framed by dense lattice and step-fret patterning with a possible small glyph-like block at the right side.
maya_0094.notes_sonnet: A tall stone column carved with a large central human figure in elaborate costume, flanked above by stacked abstract mask-like bands containing circular disc motifs, arranged in multiple horizontal registers.

maya_0095.title: Mayan stela.JPG
maya_0095.notes: A weathered stone slab carved in low relief with a grid of rounded rectangular glyph blocks arranged in multiple rows and columns, several containing small circular and face-like motifs.
maya_0095.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface divided into a grid of multiple rows and columns of individual glyph blocks, each containing abstract and rounded incised motifs including circular elements.

maya_0097.title: Museo Carlos Pellicer 05.JPG
maya_0097.notes: An eroded stone slab carved in relief with a single human figure in left profile wearing an elaborate headdress and ornaments, seated above a plain plinth edged with a wavy repeating line, plus a hatched rectangular panel at upper right.
maya_0097.notes_sonnet: A worn stone relief fragment shows a seated human figure in profile with an elaborate headdress, an arm resting forward, a plain disc-like shape beside the torso, a ribbed geometric band across the upper section, and a wavy carved line along the base.

maya_0101.title: Oxpemul Stele in situ.jpg
maya_0101.notes: A tall weathered stone slab bearing a single vertical relief of a standing frontal figure with an elaborate towering headdress, a round medallion-like ornament on the chest area, and feet visible at the base.
maya_0101.notes_sonnet: A single upright standing figure carved in relief on a tall stone slab, with an elaborate headdress at top, a circular ornament at chest level, and a small block of glyph-like marks near the base.

maya_0105.title: Piedra tallada en el Museo Maya de Cancún 39.5.jpg
maya_0105.notes: A tall vertical slab carved in low relief with a large standing human figure in profile wearing an elaborate headdress, holding a long staff-like object diagonally, and a much smaller crouching figure at his feet in the lower portion.

maya_0106.title: Plate25- Front of an Idol -p128.jpg
maya_0106.artist: Stephens, John Lloyd, 1805-1852; Catherwood, Frederick, ed
maya_0106.notes: A tall upright slab carved in deep relief with a frontal standing figure in an elaborate tall headdress, flanked and crowned by dense curvilinear scroll and mask-like motifs, set on a stepped base in a landscape drawing.
maya_0106.notes_sonnet: An upright carved stone slab (idol/stela) shows a large central human-like face and figure with headdress, flanked by dense low-relief carving including scrolls, small serpent-like and bird-like forms, and a smaller figure below the main face, all set on a stepped base.

maya_0110.title: President Alejandro Giammattei participated in the act of reopening and presentation of the renewed National Museum of Mayan Art, Archaeology and Ethnology on 2 November 2023 - 19.jpg
maya_0110.notes: A single large standing figure in profile-legged, frontal-torso pose wearing an elaborate plumed headdress and beaded ornaments, holding a long staff-like object, with a block of small square glyph cartouches at the lower right of the carved slab.
maya_0110.notes_sonnet: A single large standing human figure in elaborate feathered headdress and costume holds a staff or tool and gestures toward a bird perched on foliage, with a block of glyphs carved in the lower right corner.

maya_0111.title: President Alejandro Giammattei participated in the act of reopening and presentation of the renewed National Museum of Mayan Art, Archaeology and Ethnology on 2 November 2023 - 26.jpg
maya_0111.notes: A tall upright stone slab carved in low relief with a single standing figure in an elaborate tall headdress and ornamented costume, framed above and below by narrow bands of repeated small motifs, displayed indoors on a red plinth.
maya_0111.notes_sonnet: A tall carved stone slab shows a standing human figure with elaborate headdress in the upper register, framed above by rows of small circular/disc motifs and geometric banding, with additional carved detail lower down partly obscured by shadow and museum lighting.

maya_0113.title: President Alejandro Giammattei participated in the act of reopening and presentation of the renewed National Museum of Mayan Art, Archaeology and Ethnology on 2 November 2023 - 30.jpg
maya_0113.notes: A tall upright carved stone slab with a frontal standing figure in an elaborate tall headdress set within a recessed niche, flanked by vertical columns of small squared sign blocks and with a large panel of similar blocks filling the lower portion.
maya_0113.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a single seated human figure with an elaborate headdress framed by a niche, surrounded by dense borders of glyph blocks and repeating geometric motifs.

maya_0114.title: President Alejandro Giammattei participated in the act of reopening and presentation of the renewed National Museum of Mayan Art, Archaeology and Ethnology on 2 November 2023 - 31.jpg
maya_0114.notes: A rounded-top stone slab carved in low relief with dense curvilinear and rectilinear motifs, including scroll-filled panels and mask-like faces with square eyes stacked vertically over the whole surface.
maya_0114.notes_sonnet: An arch-topped stone slab densely carved with interlocking curvilinear and scroll-like abstract motifs and a central circular element, arranged without clear figural forms or horizontal banding.

maya_0115.title: President Alejandro Giammattei participated in the act of reopening and presentation of the renewed National Museum of Mayan Art, Archaeology and Ethnology on 2 November 2023 - 33.jpg
maya_0115.notes: A carved stone slab with an upper scene of elaborately costumed kneeling/seated figures wearing large masked or zoomorphic headdresses with plumed and fringed elements, above a lower band of cross-hatched lattice pattern interrupted by three squared glyph-like blocks.
maya_0115.notes_sonnet: An upper register shows two large horned/eared quadrupeds flanking a central tree-like or feathered motif with circular elements, above a lower register of a geometric band with zigzag lattice pattern interrupted by three square panels containing cross-and-circle motifs.

maya_0125.title: Stela 1 Los Alacranes, Campeche.jpg
maya_0125.notes: A tall weathered upright stone slab carved in low relief showing a large standing frontal figure in elaborate costume flanked by vertical columns of square glyph blocks, with smaller seated or crouching figures near the base.
maya_0125.notes_sonnet: An eroded upright stone slab shows a column of glyph blocks along the upper left edge and a carved human figure with a circular object near the lower portion, with much surface detail worn away.

maya_0126.title: Stela 1, Altar de los Reyes, Campeche, Mexico.jpg
maya_0126.notes: A heavily eroded stone block carved in low relief with rectangular blocks containing rounded, oval and circular motifs arranged in roughly two horizontal rows.
maya_0126.notes_sonnet: A large weathered stone surface bears a lower band of repeated circular/disc motifs arranged in a row beneath an area of eroded curvilinear carved lines.

maya_0127.title: Stela 2 Altar de los Reyes, Campeche, Mexico.jpg
maya_0127.notes: A roughly triangular carved stone fragment with low-relief curvilinear scrollwork, concentric circular motifs and blocky rectangular panels arranged in an upper curved zone and a lower banded zone.
maya_0127.notes_sonnet: A carved stone fragment with an interlocking spiral (scroll) pattern covering the upper portion, a diagonal bar-like element crossing the middle, and small rectangular glyph-like blocks along the lower edge.

maya_0129.title: Stela 5 by V. Garth Norman.png
maya_0129.artist: Izapa Stela 5 New World Archaeology Drawing by V. Garth Norman
maya_0129.notes: A rectangular carved panel showing a large central branching tree flanked by several seated and standing elaborately costumed human figures holding objects, framed above by a band of rectangular glyph-like blocks and below by a band of scroll/step patterning, with a small animal-like form at the bottom center.
maya_0129.notes_sonnet: A large central tree with visible roots divides a symmetrical scene of seated and standing human figures, framed above by a band of glyph-like blocks and below by a wavy geometric border.

maya_0130.title: Stela of Mayan Warrior - Archaeological Museum - Fort of San Miguel - Campeche - Mexico.jpg
maya_0130.notes: A single large standing figure in profile-headed frontal pose with an elaborate feathered headdress, ornamented chest medallion and apron, holding a long slanted object, with a column of square glyph blocks at lower right and a decorated basal panel.
maya_0130.notes_sonnet: A single large frontal human figure with an elaborate feathered headdress and ornate costume stands above a block of glyph-like text panels and a bottom register containing a large circular motif flanked by geometric shapes.

maya_0136.title: Stele, Campeche, Late Classic, 600-900 AD.jpg
maya_0136.notes: A weathered stone slab carved in low relief with a single standing figure shown with head in profile, elaborate headdress and layered ornamented costume, holding a bar-like object across the chest, with a round medallion at one side and scroll-like motifs at the base.
maya_0136.notes_sonnet: A single large, frontally-oriented anthropomorphic figure carved in relief on an irregularly shaped stone slab, wearing an elaborate headdress and holding a round shield-like object with a cross motif, flanked by curling scroll-like elements at the base.

maya_0137.title: Stele, Tabasco, Late Classic, 600-900 AD.jpg
maya_0137.notes: A tall narrow stone slab carved in low relief with a single standing figure in profile wearing an elaborate plumed headdress and ornaments, holding a long diagonal staff-like object, with a column of small square glyph-like blocks along the right edge.
maya_0137.notes_sonnet: A large vertical stone slab carved in low relief with a single standing frontal human figure wearing an elaborate tall headdress, holding an object in one raised hand, with a circular emblem on the torso and small carved glyph-like blocks arranged along the lower right edge.

maya_0138.title: Stone Stela.jpg
maya_0138.notes: A tall, heavily eroded upright stone slab carved in relief with several stacked scenes of standing figures separated by narrow horizontal bands of small square blocks, with a patterned panel near the base.
maya_0138.notes_sonnet: A tall weathered stone slab carved in multiple horizontal registers separated by plain bands, with eroded figural scenes including possible human forms in the middle sections and rows of small glyph-like blocks and geometric patterning near the top and bottom.

maya_0146.title: Tikal St05l.jpg
maya_0146.notes: A tall weathered stone slab whose narrow face is carved in low relief with a vertical grid of many rounded, densely detailed square glyph blocks, some containing small face-like motifs, with the upper portion darkened and eroded.
maya_0146.notes_sonnet: A tall narrow stone surface carved with multiple stacked rectangular blocks of dense abstract glyph-like signs, several containing small circular elements, arranged in horizontal rows down the length of the stone.

maya_0147.title: Tikal St05r.jpg
maya_0147.notes: A tall weathered stone shaft carved in low relief with a grid of rectangular glyph blocks in paired columns on the visible face, the adjacent side heavily eroded.
maya_0147.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone column carved with multiple vertically stacked blocks of glyph-like script arranged in two columns down its front face.

maya_0149.title: Tikal St10l.jpg
maya_0149.notes: A weathered upright stone column carved in low relief with vertical columns of rounded, rectangular glyph-like blocks stacked in many horizontal rows, with pitted erosion damage.
maya_0149.notes_sonnet: A narrow, elongated stone surface carved with a vertical column of stacked rectangular glyph blocks running its full length.

maya_0152.title: Tikal St13r.jpg
maya_0152.notes: A tall weathered stone shaft whose right-hand face carries a vertical column of paired rectangular glyph blocks in low relief, the left face being heavily eroded and pitted.
maya_0152.notes_sonnet: A tall stone shaft carved along one vertical face with a stacked column of square glyph blocks arranged in multiple horizontal registers, the surface pitted with erosion holes.

maya_0158.title: Tzendales Stela.png
maya_0158.notes: A single elaborately costumed standing figure in profile, wearing a large plumed headdress and ornamented kilt with round discs, holding a tall staff, with a vertical column of rectangular glyph blocks along the left edge and small subsidiary faces at the chest and belt ornament.
maya_0158.notes_sonnet: A large standing human figure in profile wearing an elaborate headdress and holding a staff, with a smaller face beside the headdress and another small face near the shoulder, a column of glyph blocks runs down the left side, and the lower garment is decorated with a field of round dot-like discs above a patterned skirt.

maya_0162.title: Árbol de la vida de Izapa.jpg
maya_0162.notes: A worn, shallow low-relief stone panel with a large central radiating plant-like or fan-shaped motif flanked by scrolling foliate forms and small seated figures with blocky glyph-like elements around the upper edges.
maya_0162.notes_sonnet: A large central tree-like form with radiating fan-shaped foliage dominates the incised surface, flanked by numerous smaller curvilinear animal-like figures on either side.

mississippian_0000.title: Braden style Birdman Lake Jackson HRoe 01.jpg
mississippian_0000.notes: A single large standing figure with a beaked animal head, elaborate rayed disc headdress with round ornaments, wing-like and banded garment elements behind and below, holding a staff-like implement in one raised hand.
mississippian_0000.notes_sonnet: A single large figure with a bird-beaked head and large feathered wings extending down the sides, holding a staff-like object, standing on a striped/banded base with circular elements above the head.

mississippian_0001.title: Cahokia Birdman tablet HRoe 2012.jpg
mississippian_0001.notes: A single low-relief bust in profile on a rounded rectangular plaque, with a pointed head covering, a large circular ear ornament, a round disc on the chest, and a field of repeated diagonal parallel lines filling the area behind and below the shoulder.
mississippian_0001.notes_sonnet: A single carved figure in profile with a beaked, bird-like head atop a human-shaped body wearing a garment with a circular ornament and a striped, wing-like or feathered shoulder covering.

mississippian_0002.title: Chromesun mississippian birdman.jpg
mississippian_0002.artist:
Herb Roe.

The original uploader was Heironymous Rowe at English Wikipedia.
mississippian_0002.notes: A single frontal figure with a human body, beaked headdress and large outspread feathered wings, wearing checkered banded ornaments and a circular chest pendant, crowned by a zigzag arch.
mississippian_0002.notes_sonnet: A symmetrical standing figure with a human body and legs, a bird head with hooked beak, and large outstretched patterned wings, topped by a zigzag arch motif.

mississippian_0005.title: Craig style gorget HRoe 2012.jpg
mississippian_0005.notes: A roughly circular openwork plaque carved in low relief with an encircling scalloped/concentric border enclosing a single crouching or dancing human-bodied figure with a large feathered wing, a patterned skirt, holding a rayed disc-like object in one raised hand and a hafted implement below the other.
mississippian_0005.notes_sonnet: A single large seated figure with a human-like body, a beaked or animal-like head, and one wing shown on its back, encircled by a carved border with a small disc-shaped object near its feet.

mississippian_0006.title: Elder birdman plate HRoe 2012.jpg
mississippian_0006.notes: A tall narrow carved panel in relief showing a frontal standing human-like figure with arms outstretched beneath a large rayed circular face at the top, flanked by crescent and chevron patterning and a fluted fan-shaped base.
mississippian_0006.notes_sonnet: A tall vertical panel shows a face-like bird-human head with radiating rays at the top, above a standing human-like body flanked by crescent or disc shapes, ending in a fringed, pointed lower section with a starburst motif and a fan-like band of parallel lines at the base.

mississippian_0007.title: Embossed copper plate depicting Birdman,one of so-called Rogan pates.JPG
mississippian_0007.notes: Line drawing of a single frontal standing figure in elaborate costume with a tall crested headdress topped by a curved beak-like form, beaded and hatched bands on head, arms, waist and belt, a round chest ornament, and several long staff-like elements flanking the body.
mississippian_0007.notes_sonnet: A single richly adorned humanoid figure wearing an elaborate feathered headdress and wing-like costume elements on both sides, with beaded necklaces, banded belt with a central disc, and a small fish-like object held in one hand.

mississippian_0008.title: Emmons mask HRoe 2012.jpg
mississippian_0008.notes: A frontal human face sculpted in the round, shown split down the middle with a reconstructed/painted half on the left and a weathered, cracked original half on the right, topped by a crown-like or notched headdress edge.
mississippian_0008.notes_sonnet: A single stylized face wearing a crenellated crown, split vertically with one half smooth painted skin tones and the other half showing weathered, cracked wood-like textured surface with green patina.

mississippian_0009.title: Engraved stone tablet Castalian Springs HRoe 2011.jpg
mississippian_0009.notes: A single large profile figure with a human head and elaborate headgear attached to a winged, spotted body with feathered wing and tail elements, drawn in fine outline on an irregular pale panel.
mississippian_0009.notes_sonnet: A single large figure with a human head in profile and an elaborate winged, feathered body decorated with rows of circular dots, drawn in fine incised outline on an irregularly shaped pale surface.

mississippian_0010.title: Etowah Dancing Warrior plate HRoe 2013.jpg
mississippian_0010.notes: A single carved relief panel shows one large seated frontal figure with a profile head, elaborate crested headdress, beaded ornaments and patterned belt and kilt, flanked by broad wing-like plumed forms spreading symmetrically to either side.
mississippian_0010.notes_sonnet: A large symmetrical bird form with outstretched, feathered wings encloses a smaller seated human figure wearing an ornate headdress, necklace, and patterned belt at the center.

mississippian_0011.title: Etowah avian style repousse plate HRoe 2012.jpg
mississippian_0011.notes: A single large frontal figure with a hooked beaked head, a ringed neck, outspread wings rendered in rows of overlapping crescent scales, small five-fingered hands emerging at the sides, three raised bosses on the torso, and a flaring skirt-like lower body.
mississippian_0011.notes_sonnet: A single large frontal bird figure with spread wings composed of overlapping feather-like scales, a ringed neck, clawed feet, and a body decorated with raised circular bosses forming a mask-like pattern, rendered in a mottled bronze-green surface.

mississippian_0015.title: EtowahChief.JPG
mississippian_0015.notes: A large painted standing figure whose body is covered with fine incised/painted linear and curvilinear patterning, holding a bladed implement raised in one hand and a mask-like object in the other, with banded armlets, a striped sash and a crested headdress.
mississippian_0015.notes_sonnet: A carved standing figure with a beaked animal-mask headdress, incised body markings, holding a raised object overhead and a container-like item in the lowered hand, with a striped wrapped garment at the waist.

mississippian_0018.title: Fainsislandpage35spider.png
mississippian_0018.artist: Ancient artifact. Illustration from above named book.
mississippian_0018.notes: A round plaque with a toothed outer rim and concentric rings enclosing a band of repeated openwork teardrop shapes, with a small many-legged creature in raised relief around a central perforated boss.
mississippian_0018.notes_sonnet: A circular disc with a scalloped/toothed outer rim and an inner ring of triangular cut-outs surrounding a central raised spider or insect-like figure with a small circular disc at its center.

mississippian_0045.title: Rogan plate 1 birdman HRoe 2012.jpg
mississippian_0045.notes: A single large seated figure in profile-headed frontal pose wearing an elaborate headdress, beaded ornaments and a broad spread of long feather-like plumes forming wing and tail shapes, holding a rod-like object at upper left and a rectangular panel-like object in the lap, with a small grotesque head at lower right; the surface is carved in low relief on a plaque with damaged/missing areas.
mississippian_0045.notes_sonnet: A central kneeling or crouching human-like figure with an elaborate headdress is surrounded by large outstretched wing-like appendages patterned with striped bands, giving the impression of a bird costume or hybrid form, with a raised arm holding a staff-like object.

mississippian_0052.title: S.E.C.C. hero twins 3 HRoe 2007-transparent.png
mississippian_0052.notes: Two nearly identical elaborately costumed human figures in profile flank a tall central vertical panel topped by a frontal animal-like face, each holding round rayed disc objects, all set within an oval field.
mississippian_0052.notes_sonnet: Two mirrored seated human figures facing a central vertical band topped by a small frontal bird-like face, each human holding a round disc-shaped object with a rod, joined by a wide patterned belt with a central circular medallion.

mississippian_0055.title: S.E.C.C. shaman dancing HRoe 2008.jpg
mississippian_0055.notes: A single frontal red-bodied figure with an animal-muzzled masked head and curling headdress with round knobs stands with arms outstretched, holding a pointed shaft in one hand and a curved implement in the other, with rows of dark banded pendant forms hanging from its arms and patterned belt and limb bands.
mississippian_0055.notes_sonnet: A central humanoid figure with a bird/animal-headed mask or costume, outstretched arms holding a spear on one side and a bow on the other, with dark feather-like wing shapes extending from the arms and a decorated torso with geometric bands and a belt.

mississippian_0075.title: Whelk shell cup, Woolaroc museum.jpg
mississippian_0075.notes: A curved pale hard surface bears fine dark incised lines forming several stacked zigzag bands with spiky projections, each terminating in a horned head with a dotted round eye and toothed jaw.
mississippian_0075.notes_sonnet: A curved bone or shell-like surface is covered with three or more registers of dense zigzag/chevron patterning, with a stylized bird head with a rounded eye visible at the lower left edge.

gotland_0000.title: Austers (I).JPG
gotland_0000.notes: A tapering stone slab carved in shallow relief: an elongated pointed-snouted aquatic creature with a toothed/serrated line beneath it across the upper zone, two large linked spirals occupying the centre, and running key/meander borders along the top and right edges.
gotland_0000.notes_sonnet: An eroded carved stone slab shows an elongated bird-like creature with a spiral eye near the top, a small running human figure beside it, two large incised spiral motifs below, and a running-dog or wave pattern bordering the right edge.

gotland_0002.title: Bildstein-Hamra 01.jpg
gotland_0002.notes: A roughly rectangular stone slab incised with thin lines forming a central cross-shaped motif with a partial ring or arc around its head, framed by long narrow bands filled with angular linear characters along the edges.
gotland_0002.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab shows a central geometric device combining a large circle, a vertical stepped post, and radiating tick marks, flanked on both left and right margins by vertical columns of small incised script/glyph characters.

gotland_0003.title: Bildstein-Hamra 02.jpg
gotland_0003.notes: A rectangular stone slab with three ruled lines of incised lettering across the upper third, flanked by two small mirrored scroll motifs, above a large symmetrical foliate cross-shaped ornament of curling leaf tendrils filling the lower field.
gotland_0003.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab with three lines of lettering across the top within a bordered band, and a large symmetrical foliate cross/scroll motif incised below on the plain stone surface.

gotland_0004.title: Bildstein-Hamra 03.jpg
gotland_0004.notes: A rectangular stone slab mounted on a wall bearing lines of angular incised glyph characters running along its upper edge, one long side, and the lower portion, with the central surface left blank.
gotland_0004.notes_sonnet: A vertical stone slab with an incised border framing lines of angular script-like characters arranged in horizontal rows along the top and down the left and lower portions of the surface.

gotland_0005.title: Bildstein-Rute kyrka 1.jpg
gotland_0005.notes: A tall rectangular slab bears an incised, red-outlined design of a large ring-shaped interlace knot in the upper area rising from a broad flaring shaft with a smaller circular loop below, roughly mirror-symmetric about the vertical axis.
gotland_0005.notes_sonnet: An upright stone slab bears a symmetrical incised design of interlocking knotwork/spiral motifs in the upper portion, transitioning downward into a stylized triangular and circular pendant-like form near the base.

gotland_0007.title: Bildsten - Historiska museet - DIG 53920.jpg
gotland_0007.notes: A tall mushroom-shaped slab carved in low relief with a continuous interlace border, an upper scene of a large four-legged animal with small figures, and a lower scene of a vessel with a latticed rectangular sail on a mast above a curved hull with small figures; the base is plain and worn.
gotland_0007.notes_sonnet: A tapering stone slab bordered by an interlacing knotwork band, showing a mounted rider atop a horse in the upper field, a row of text/glyphs below, and a large lattice-patterned vessel or sledge-like object with curling extensions occupying the lower-middle portion of the field.

gotland_0008.title: Bildsten - Historiska museet - DIG 53921.jpg
gotland_0008.notes: A large fine-line outline design on an irregular slab: a broad arched frame enclosing a trapezoidal hull-like body with a central vertical line and flanking angled elements, set above a lower band of repeated curved crest-like motifs.
gotland_0008.notes_sonnet: An incised design shows a large vessel-like or boat-like form with a tall arched outline and flared upper corners, a central vertical staff-like line, and a lower band of repeated scalloped/wave-like curves, all bordered by a plain framing arch.

gotland_0009.title: Bildsten - Historiska museet - DIG 53923.jpg
gotland_0009.notes: A shaped slab with a framed two-register panel of dark silhouette human figures — upper ones with raised arms and unclear or missing heads, lower ones robed with one bending over a large oval handled vessel beside a slender vertical shaft — bordered on the left by a plaited interlace band.
gotland_0009.notes_sonnet: A carved stone slab bordered by interlace and glyph-like marks, showing two registers of standing human figures, one holding a long staff-like object, arranged within a framed panel.

gotland_0018.title: Bildsten Garde 124-1 - KMB - 16000300017772.jpg
gotland_0018.notes: A weathered rock surface bearing a shallow pecked/incised outline of a four-legged animal in profile with raised neck and tail, plus a few faint linear marks above it.
gotland_0018.notes_sonnet: A faint, roughly pecked or incised outline resembling a four-legged animal is visible on a weathered rock surface, with little other discernible imagery.

gotland_0026.title: Bildsten Hellvi.jpg
gotland_0026.notes: A framed rectangular slab with an upper zone containing two schematic long-legged horned animals and a lower zone with a large circle enclosing a whirling multi-armed spiral motif.
gotland_0026.notes_sonnet: A stone slab bordered by an incised frame shows two quadruped-like animal figures in the upper third and a large spiral/pinwheel disc motif inscribed within a circle in the middle of the surface.

gotland_0111.title: Fornsalen - Bildstein - Schiff unter Segeln.jpg
gotland_0111.notes: An arched slab carved in low relief with a recessed arched panel containing a large rectangular field of diamond lattice crossed by a vertical pole, above a curved boat-like lower body edged with a row of overlapping circles.
gotland_0111.notes_sonnet: An arch-shaped stone slab incised with a vertical central pole dividing an upper lattice/diamond patterned band from a lower rounded basin-like container holding several round objects (discs or spheres).

gotland_0112.title: Fornsalen - Bildstein - Schiffszeichnung.jpg
gotland_0112.notes: A rounded, fan-shaped stone slab bearing fine incised lines: a double-line border framing the field with small square panels containing crossed/hatched motifs, a central curved hull-like vessel with upturned ends carrying a rectangular panel and several small round heads or knobs along its interior, and a lattice grid pattern across the lower zone.
gotland_0112.notes_sonnet: An incised outline shows a box-like container or vessel shape with a bird-like head and tail emerging from it, set within a curved border decorated with a geometric band along the rim.

gotland_0113.title: Fornsalen - Bildstein - Spirale und Hirsche.jpg
gotland_0113.notes: A tall slab bears a large multi-armed whirling rosette encircled by a ring of small discs, flanked by four small antlered quadrupeds in profile, with running wave-and-spiral bands framing the top and bottom.
gotland_0113.notes_sonnet: A large central circular motif with a pinwheel/spiral pattern surrounded by a ring of dots dominates the slab, flanked above by two small horned quadrupeds and below by two more horned quadrupeds, with wavy-line geometric bands framing the top and bottom edges.

gotland_0115.title: Fornsalen - Runenstein - Kampfszene (cropped).jpg
gotland_0115.notes: A worn painted panel framed by a zigzag border showing one large four-legged creature whose upper body ends in a human-like head with long hair and a raised arm, with a smaller limbed figure overlapping its body and curving band-like forms below.
gotland_0115.notes_sonnet: A large horned quadruped with a serpentine tail dominates the scene, ridden or accompanied by a small human figure holding a staff-like object, framed by vertical zigzag borders.

gotland_0116.title: Fornsalen - Runenstein - Kampfszene.jpg
gotland_0116.notes: An arched slab framed by a zigzag border, with an upper band of three standing helmeted human figures holding upright pointed implements and a lower band filled by one large striding four-legged animal with a curved element over its back.
gotland_0116.notes_sonnet: An arched stone slab bordered by a zigzag band, upper register shows three standing human figures holding raised weapons/staffs, lower register shows a large four-legged animal being ridden by a smaller human figure with a serpentine or tailed creature beneath.

gotland_0117.title: Fornsalen – Bildstein mit Schleifenquadrat.jpg
gotland_0117.notes: An arched slab carved with a large central roundel containing an interlaced looping knot, framed by mirrored scroll and tendril motifs, a wavy scrolled border band across the top, and small concentric circles below the roundel.
gotland_0117.notes_sonnet: A flat carved slab with an incised scrolling spiral band across the top, flanked by vertical S-scroll bands down each side, a large central circular medallion filled with interlocking scroll motifs, and a lower row of small circles and further scrollwork.

gotland_0118.title: G 157.jpg
gotland_0118.notes: A pale plastered wall bears fine incised/drawn linear marks: a vertical column of angular sign-like characters at right, crossing lattice and zigzag line fields, dashed horizontal lines, and a small row of circles at lower left.
gotland_0118.notes_sonnet: Incised lines on a plastered wall surface show vertical columns of glyph-like marks, crosshatched lattice patterns, and a vertical row of small circles with lines beneath a horizontal dashed line.

gotland_0122.title: Hablingbo kyrka - KMB - 16000200020641.jpg
