tanum_0328.title: Tanum 111.jpg
tanum_0328.notes: Red-painted pecked figures on a grey rock surface show several long crescent boat-like shapes with rows of vertical strokes, small stick human figures (one holding a raised object), a small four-legged animal, and a vertical line of round dots along the right edge.
tanum_0328.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface incised with red-painted pecked motifs including several boat-like forms with vertical strokes along their hulls, small human figures holding raised objects, scattered circular dots, and a vertical column of round cupmarks descending the right side.

tanum_0332.title: Tanum 115.jpg
tanum_0332.notes: A sloping rock surface bearing red-painted carved outlines: one very large elongated curved-ended vessel shape with rows of vertical strokes along its top, surrounded by many smaller similar craft, small stick-figure humans, and a few indistinct animal-like forms arranged in loose horizontal bands.
tanum_0332.notes_sonnet: A large stone surface incised/pecked with numerous ship or boat-like elongated hull shapes with vertical stroke 'ribs' representing crew or oars, alongside small human figures, one holding a staff-like object, all rendered in red-filled pecked lines across an unbounded rock panel.

tanum_0333.title: Tanum 116.jpg
tanum_0333.notes: A sloping rock surface pecked and filled with red pigment shows numerous elongated hull-like outlines with upturned ends, each topped by rows of short vertical strokes, plus a few small stick-figure humans, some with raised arms, a couple of small four-legged animals and a circular motif, scattered in loose horizontal tiers.
tanum_0333.notes_sonnet: A flat rock surface incised/pecked with numerous large boat-like elongated shapes with vertical rib lines and upturned ends, interspersed with small stick-figure humans, small quadruped animals, dots and circular marks, all rendered in dark red pigment over the stone.

tanum_0334.title: Tanum 117.jpg
tanum_0334.notes: A sloping rock surface bears numerous red-filled pecked outlines: several long curved boat-like hulls with rows of short vertical strokes, scattered small human figures (some with raised arms or holding a long shaft), a disc-and-line motif at upper left, and a line of round cup-shaped dots running down the right side.
tanum_0334.notes_sonnet: A weathered stone surface incised with red-painted pecked figures including several boat-like curved forms with vertical strokes, small human figures holding staff-like objects, dots, and a vertical line of dots along the right edge, arranged in loosely horizontal bands.

tanum_0338.title: Tanum 121.jpg
tanum_0338.notes: A sloping rock surface carved and painted red with several long curved boat-like outlines topped by rows of short vertical strokes ending in small stick figures, plus scattered small human and four-legged figures, dots and short lines arranged in loose horizontal bands.
tanum_0338.notes_sonnet: A carved stone surface shows multiple large boat-like forms with rows of upright figures along their lengths in the lower two-thirds, while the upper portion contains smaller scattered human and animal figures, dots, and linear marks arranged without a clear register system.

tanum_0339.title: Tanum 122.jpg
tanum_0339.notes: A rock surface with red-painted carved outlines: one very large elongated hull-like form topped by a row of repeated vertical strokes, with smaller similar forms, small stick-figure humans and a few small round marks scattered across the upper part.
tanum_0339.notes_sonnet: A large elongated ship-like outline with many vertical crew-lines dominates the lower register, incised in red pigment into rock, while smaller human figures, a four-legged animal, disc shapes, and staff-like objects appear scattered in an upper, less organized register.

tanum_0340.title: Tanum 123.jpg
tanum_0340.notes: A rock surface with red-filled pecked outlines showing stacked rows of long boat-like hulls with rows of vertical crew strokes and small dots, small stick human figures with raised arms, one or two four-legged animals near the top, and a large lattice/grid of thick lines occupying the lower third.
tanum_0340.notes_sonnet: A pecked stone surface with red-painted lines showing several boat-like elongated shapes with upturned ends stacked in bands, a large circular form at top, small human and animal figures, a figure holding a raised staff, and a lower zone filled with vertical parallel strokes crossed by horizontal dividing lines.

tanum_0341.title: Tanum 124.jpg
tanum_0341.notes: A curved rock face carved and painted red with numerous long boat-like hulls bearing rows of short vertical strokes and small stick figures, plus a large lattice-like framed shape at left.
tanum_0341.notes_sonnet: A rock surface densely carved with numerous stylized four-legged animals (antlered/horned) shown in profile with elongated legs and bodies, filled in with red pigment, scattered across the stone without clear horizontal banding.

tanum_0344.title: Tanum 127.jpg
tanum_0344.notes: A red-pigmented stick figure with raised arms stands at the left of a granular rock surface, facing a long horizontal undulating serpentine line that runs off the right edge, with a small solid red oval dot above it.
tanum_0344.notes_sonnet: A red-painted human figure with raised arms stands to the left of a long, sinuous snake-like line that undulates across the rock surface, with a small red disc and a green lichen patch near the right edge.

tanum_0347.title: Tanum 130.jpg
tanum_0347.notes: A rock surface with red-painted pecked outlines: an upper zone of stacked crescent hull shapes topped by rows of short vertical strokes plus a small rayed rosette, a middle zone of several striding stick-like human figures with raised arms holding hafted implements, and a large plain ring with an internal hook at lower right.
tanum_0347.notes_sonnet: A rock surface incised/pecked with red-painted outline figures including numerous elongated human figures holding staffs or weapons, curved boat-like or horn-like shapes at the top, scattered small glyph-like marks, and a large circular disc motif with an internal curved line near the bottom right.

tanum_0348.title: Tanum 131.jpg
tanum_0348.notes: A red-filled rock-carved surface showing a large striding human figure with outstretched arms holding a T-shaped implement in the upper zone, a branching linear motif at mid-left, and a long curved vessel-like form with a dense row of repeated short vertical strokes along the bottom.
tanum_0348.notes_sonnet: A large red-painted humanoid figure with raised, weapon-like arms stands above a small quadruped and a long banded serpentine or crocodile-like form with repeating patterned segments along the bottom edge.

tanum_0351.title: Tanum 134.jpg
tanum_0351.notes: A carved and red-painted humanlike figure with a torso rendered as multiple concentric rings holds a long horizontal bar across its arms, with a small dot above it and two long horizontal lines with short connecting strokes across the lower part of the stone.
tanum_0351.notes_sonnet: A pecked reddish figure with a spiral-patterned round body, bent humanoid legs, and a curved beak-like head is centered between two horizontal lines, with a small circular dot above and a broken horizontal band below.

tanum_0359.title: Tanum 225-1 - KMB - 16000300017922.jpg
tanum_0359.notes: Deeply pecked curvilinear grooves on a weathered rock face form a large elongated animal-like figure with limb-like extensions, accompanied by scattered small round cup-marks and a hooked curved motif above.
tanum_0359.notes_sonnet: A pecked rock surface shows an abstract curved line resembling a bird-like form at the top and a spider- or scorpion-like shape with radiating legs below, connected by incised linear marks.
